sections.title: NAKAMICHI NAKAMICHI1000P
sections.overview: The D/A converter was developed in combination with the Nakamichi1000 DAT deck in pursuit of the highest sound quality beyond the highest analog deck.The digital filter uses a 20-bit 8 x oversampling digital filter.The D/A conversion section uses a 20-bit full calibration D/A conversion system.This circuit uses three key technologies : digital ROM calibration, tandem 20-bit converter, and glitch eraser to achieve extremely high conversion accuracy and extremely low distortion rate at the theoretical limit.In digital ROM calibration, all bits are digitally corrected by a calibrated ROM that stores correction data for each D/A converter IC. This prevents characteristic changes due to time and temperature, and realizes extremely high conversion accuracy.Calibration and writing data to the ROM are performed for each unit at the time of shipment from the factory. First, a 22-bit A/D converter for measurement is connected to a 1000p test point in operation to accurately measure the D/A conversion error. Then, the subtle peculiarities of each converter IC are grasped by special arithmetic processing assuming all situations. Then, this error data is written in the ROM, which is mounted on the D to A converter circuit board of each unit. Unlike analog methods such as semi-fixed resistors, the ROM directly adjusts digital data to achieve complete accuracy correction.This circuit completely eliminates the slight noise associated with the original sound, which could not be eliminated by conventional D/A conversion.In the tandem 20-bit converter, the 20-bit output of the digital filter is first divided into upper 14 bits and lower 6 bits, then processed by a dedicated 16-bit D/A converter and digitally added again to achieve 20-bit operation. Each D/A converter operates with a sufficient margin. For the lower 6 bits, which require particularly high precision, only the high-order bits of the 16-bit converter are used to achieve linear conversion. For the upper 14 bits, a margin of 2 bits is left to ensure conversion accuracy.Complete accuracy correction by digital ROM calibration has achieved the 20-bit limit performance.In a typical D/A converter, a signal contaminated by glitch noise is sent directly to an analog circuit, where the glitch is removed (sampled and held) in an analog manner. However, in this method, the switching noise of the sample-and-hold circuit itself masks a small signal of 60 to 80 dB, making it difficult to reproduce music accurately.In order to eliminate this glitch noise at the digital data stage, it is equipped with a glitch eraser originally developed by Nakamichi. In this circuit, in order to eliminate the very minute glitch noise at each bit transition except for the 0 cross point, which has been considered as a problem until now, every occurrence point of the glitch is predicted in advance, and it is completely cancelled out, realizing an ultra-low distortion rate of 0.0015% which is the theoretical limit.The A/D converter uses a sample hole dressing auto-calibration A/D converter.In this circuit, the charge comparison method, the state-of-the-art A/D conversion method at that time, has been put into practical use for audio applications. By using the charge to weight each bit, the sample-and-hold circuit, which was the cause of sound quality degradation in A/D conversion, is eliminated.In addition, high-precision A/D conversion has been realized by the adoption of an auto-bit calibration system that automatically calibrates the weighting accuracy of each bit and a 16-bit 2 x oversampling digital filter.The Autobit Calibration System starts automatically when the power is turned on and is tuned to nearly perfect 16-bit accuracy in 1.4 seconds using a digital tuning method to prevent accuracy degradation due to aging.It employs a twin PLL stabilized interface, and Nakamichi's unique digital data stabilizer and two PLLs shut out disturbances such as jitter superimposed on digital signals.Equipped with a 32-dot peak level meter that reads digital data directly.This meter is a professional specification ultra-high precision type with an error limit of   0.2 dB. The discrete driving circuit and dedicated LSI enable full static lighting without adversely affecting sound quality.This meter has a peak hold function and a meter off function.The audio circuit uses a fully balanced discrete transmission system.A multi-power supply is used for the power supply section to eliminate mutual interference between stages, and an isolated ground system to eliminate mutual interference via ground.Resonance braking structure is adopted.Uses a full static indicator.Equipped with analog level volume.Two types of digital input / output terminals are mounted : coaxial and optical.Equipped with DAT mutual copy function.Equipped with a headphone terminal with dedicated level volume.It is equipped with an emphasis switch.LC-OFC Class 1 audio cable is included.There was a business model with almost the same contents except for some specifications.

sections.title: NAKAMICHI CDPLAYER2
sections.overview: CD player using music bank system.It uses a unique music bank system to enable multiple disc playback without sacrificing sound quality or operability.The Music Bank System is equipped with a CD stocker inside and can store up to six CDs. Therefore, a total of seven CDs can be played together with the discs on the tray. This unique structure makes it possible to play a single CD with the same operability as a normal CD player. It also eliminates the mechanical noise and clumsy movement seen in the magazine system.A total of 7 discs can be played continuously, 50 songs can be stored, and 7 discs can be played at full random.A magnetic chucking type disk stabilizer is mounted on the tray part to suppress the influence of external vibration and to damp the resonance of the CD itself.The digital filter uses an 8 x oversampling digital filter.The analog filter is a third order linear phase Bessel type analog filter.The D/A converter uses an EL (Enhanced Linearity) 20-bit D/A converter that simultaneously pursues multi-bit and improved conversion accuracy.With EL20-bit, the 20-bit data sent from the digital filter is recomputed and converted into two sets of 16-bit data, one set of high-level signal data and the other set of low-level signal data based on -24dB. These data are processed separately by two D/A converters for each channel. After the D/A conversion, these data are combined. sections.title: NAKAMICHI OMS-30
sections.overview: A CD player that emphasizes reproduction of low-level signals.A newly developed deglitching system is used between the D/A converter and the analog circuits.In a typical CD-player, the digital signal is converted by a D/A converter into an analog signal, and sent through a sample-and-hold circuit to an analog low-pass filter. The sample-and-hold circuit removes the glitch noise that is unavoidably attached to the output of the D/A converter. However, since this circuit consists of analog switches and capacitors made of semiconductors, parts are connected in series with the signal line, so that delicate signals tend to be buried in the noise. To this point, Nakamichi uses a newly developed deglitching system to remove the glitch without using a sample-and-hold circuit.This deglitching system uses a transistor whose switching speed is more than one order of magnitude faster than conventional switches. When the switch is closed, the output of the D/A converter is muted. This eliminates the need for a transistor to be connected in series to the signal line, and only the glitch signal is cut off quickly. Moreover, since the switching time is extremely short, there is no need to store data in a capacitor.By adopting this deglitching system, we are able to reliably reproduce minute signals as small as -90dB, which were previously buried in noise.The digital filter uses a 16-bit digital filter, which moves unwanted high-frequency signals (sidebands) away to twice the higher frequency, making it possible to use a relatively low-order, slow analog filter.The D/A converter uses a 16-bit D/A converter using a highly accurate ladder type IC.The analog filter is a 5th-order Chebyshev type active filter. Since this filter is of relatively low order in the active type, phase characteristics (especially group delay characteristics) are also good. The cutoff frequency is also set at 30 kHz, and almost flat group delay characteristics are obtained up to 20 kHz.The power supply section uses a unique multi-regulated power supply and a dedicated master power regulator to provide ideal power supply to the analog section. In addition, each local power regulator and master power regulator have a non-NFB power supply configuration with no feedback loop, so they are not affected by voltage fluctuations and provide clean power supply.In addition, the ground line uses an isolated ground system. The power line of the analog section incorporates a buffer with transistors. The current flows from + to -, and the ground only regulates the reference potential. Thus, even if noise or contamination is present in the current, it is not affected by the ground potential. This eliminates interference between the ground lines of analog circuits.The pickup section uses a 3-beam laser pickup with enhanced information pickup capability of the central main beam.In addition, a newly developed LSI for digital signal processing, which is highly integrated, is used to suppress the generation of digital noise and minimize interference with analog circuits. In addition, the servo section is independent of this LSI to improve the tracking performance to the disk.It employs a master clock method in which multiple LSIs for signal processing are synchronized by a single crystal oscillator to prevent beat noise due to interference between multiple clocks.The disk drive mechanism is floated from the main base chassis by a damper composed of spring and rubber, and is structured to be less affected by internal resonance and external vibration.For the chucking method to fix the disk to the center spindle, a unique method of Nakamichi is adopted. When chucking, a centering mechanism that tapers the spindle with aluminum shavings works to accurately hold the center of the disk on the axis of the spindle, thereby preventing read errors due to disk eccentricity.In addition, the chucking arm that holds the disk employs a magnet chuck method that uses permanent magnets to fix the disk. In this method, the chucking arm is completely separated from the disk when the disk is mounted, so that it is not affected by vibrations from the chassis, contributing to improved traceability of the laser pickup.It has a program memory function of up to 15 songs.In addition to adding and modifying memory programs, you can also display the total time since the first song stored in memory program and memory when called.In addition, it is equipped with a one touch memory function. If you perform a memory operation during normal playback, the music you are listening to can be stored as it is.It is equipped with a time counter display function. When a disc is loaded, the service mode displays the total number of tracks and the total playing time. In normal regenerating condition, the time counter display can be switched to one of three types : track / time / remaining time. When playing back a memory, you can make a call to a stored program.It is equipped with skip search and double speed queuing function.It uses a direct peration function, and when you press the play button with the disc table open, it is automatically loaded and starts playing.Equipped with a repeat play function.Equipped with headphone output terminal with output adjustment volume.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.overview:
208,000 (around 1986)  190,000 (around 1989)

A CD player that suppresses glitches that occur during D/A conversion.The cost performance of OMS-50II is improved by simplifying the OMS-70II by omitting the remote control and headphone output.The newly developed glitch free D/A conversion system is used for the D/A conversion section, eliminating the sample-and-hold circuit.The analog circuit of a typical CD player consists of a D/A converter followed by a sample-and-hold circuit followed by an analog low-pass filter. This sample-and-hold circuit mutes and removes the fine whisker-like digital noise called glitch, which is seen in the analog waveform output from the D/A converter, and samples and holds only the clean signal. However, the sample-and-hold circuit consists of analog switches, capacitors, and other components that are inferior in sound quality. Internal resistance of the switch itself, mixing of switching noise, and deterioration of sound quality due to capacitors occur.In a glitch free D/A conversion system, a 16-bit digital signal, which is over-sampled by a digital filter by a factor of four, is first passed through a photocoupler to block the noise of the servo system. Next, data is converted into serial / parallel data, held in the state of parallel data, and each bit is output simultaneously with Lch and Rch. In order to prevent the occurrence of glitch, the D/A converter is strictly controlled by a digital griding circuit so that the switches of each bit operate simultaneously, so that the occurrence of glitch is close to 0.As a result, the D/A converter achieves an excellent distortion factor of 0.0015% or less and eliminates the sample-and-hold circuit from the analog section.The digital filter uses a 16-bit 4-times oversampling digital filter.By over-sampling the 44.1 kHz PCM signal to 176.4 kHz, a factor of four, the lower limit of unwanted noise is reduced to 156.4 kHz. This makes it possible to use a third order linear phase Bessel filter with excellent phase and transient response characteristics.The D/A converter uses a dual configuration 16-bit high-speed D/A converter with a built-in high-precision ladder resistor network made of a Nichrome thin film. It achieves high speed and high conversion accuracy by processing 16-bit digital signals that have been oversampled by a digital filter as they are.An optical transmission system using a photo coupler is adopted after the digital filter to prevent digital noise from being transmitted through the ground loop.For digital circuits, we are promoting the use of IC components to make the circuit smaller and reduce noise generation. For analog circuits, we have adopted a large circuit board and each circuit block is laid out loosely. In addition, the analog circuit board is sealed with an aluminum shield case to protect music signals from noise coming from the air.In addition, three layers of pure copper bus bars for power supply are placed between the D/A converter and the analog filter to provide a shielding effect.The power supply section has separate transformer windings for analog circuits (after the photocoupler) and digital circuits (servo and logic control). The rectifier circuit is also separated. A line filter is inserted into the power supply line of the digital circuit to prevent noise from mixing into the analog circuit due to the capacitance between windings inside the transformer.In addition, as a countermeasure for analog circuits, the power supply consists of two stages. First, a master power regulator is used for the analog section winding, and then an independent local power regulator is used for each stage of the L/R channel to further stabilize the voltage. In addition, the local power regulator and master power regulator are non-NFB power supplies with no feedback loop. This is related to the low NFB of power amplifiers, and reduces the influence of voltage fluctuations between stages. For stages other than analog filters, local power regulators are also used in relay circuits and other circuits.Each regulator does not use an IC, but uses a discrete configuration of transistors, and is designed with an emphasis on the grade of power supply as much as signal system.It uses an opposed ground system, and the earth line is designed with sufficient consideration.In a general circuit, the current of each stage flows from plus to ground and from ground to minus. However, when various currents from each stage flow into the signal ground, the reference ground potential fluctuates, and the effect of the flutter affects each stage, damaging the stereo image and making the sound muddy.In the OMS-70II, an FET buffer is incorporated in the power supply line so that the current flows from plus to minus. The ground is designed to function only to regulate the reference potential. This prevents noise or contamination from entering the current, and therefore the DC stability of the power supply is improved. In addition, the Zener diode, which has less influence on sound quality, is used instead of the DC coupling capacitor as the stabilizing power supply.For the analog filter, a third active type linear phase Bessel filter with a cutoff frequency of 30 khz is used discretely.The Bessel filter consists of a two stage DC amplifier. The bare characteristics of the amplifier are enhanced as much as possible. As a result, a low distortion rate of 0.0003% can be achieved by applying only a small amount of NFB. The left and right channels are perfectly symmetrical, and the front and back of each channel are powered by independent regulators, reducing interference between the channels.High-grade audio-only parts carefully selected through audibility tests, such as metal film resistors, mica capacitors, Cerafine capacitors, and completely non-inductive capacitors, are used, and brass cap type resistors for NFB are used.The input section of each stage is a differential input by Hi-gm dual FET, and the gold plated pin jack is directly attached to the analog circuit board to prevent deterioration of sound quality caused by wiring.The pickup section uses a 3-beam / astigmatic laser pickup with enhanced information pick-up capability of the central main beam, taking care to obtain more accurate information from the disc before relying on error correction.The servo circuit also employs a newly developed digital signal processing LSI. This LSI has a built-in mechanism that performs focus and hold until the RF signal from the laser pickup passes through the scratch when the RF signal from the laser pickup drops out due to a scratch at the time of disk manufacturing. This LSI prevents sound skipping and sticking caused by the scratch.Multiple LSIs for signal processing use a master clock system that synchronizes with a single crystal to prevent beat noise due to interference between clocks.In order to suppress the effects of internal resonance and external vibration, we have devised disk chucking.First of all, the disk drive mechanism is attached directly to the zinc alloy die-cast chassis to increase its rigidity and is independent of the main base chassis and disk loading mechanism. Moreover, the disk drive mechanism is completely floated from the main base chassis by means of spring and damping material so that it is less susceptible to internal resonance and external vibration.In addition, the chucking arm that holds the disk employs a magnet chuck system. When the disk is mounted, the permanent magnet securely fixes the disk so that the arm completely separates from the disk, preventing transmission of chassis vibration to the disk. In addition, the unique centering mechanism prevents read errors due to disk eccentricity.Equipped with time / total time / remaining time display function.When a disc is loaded, the total number of tracks and total playing time are displayed for approximately five seconds. In normal regenerating condition, the time counter display can be switched between three types : Time, Total Time, and Time Remaining.On OMS-70II, these three types of displays are also available for programs stored in memory during memory playback.FL tube is used for the display part.Uses gold-plated output terminal.It is equipped with functions such as skip search, double speed queuing, repeat play, and direct operation.The system remote terminal is mounted, and when the control amplifier CA-70 is connected, it can be operated by the wireless remote control included with the CA-70.

sections.title: NAKAMICHI NAKAMICHI1000
sections.overview: The DAT transport was developed to be the world's best digital audio recorder.The mechanism part adopts the next-generation DAT mechanism FAST.This mechanism employs a quick-loading arm, which provides ideal control of arm speed and force by means of a unique special link arm similar to human joint movement and an interactive microprocessor. This protects the tape while achieving an amazing loading speed of more than twice that of conventional devices.In addition, with conventional DAT, the tape is always wound around the head even when it is fast-forwarded or rewound, so not only does the quick winding speed slow down, but it also places a heavy burden on the tape itself. To solve this problem, FAST uses a simple tape path structure to set a half-load position. When the FF or REW button is pressed twice in succession, the tape is set to a state completely separated from the head, and quick winding starts immediately at an average speed of 400 x. When quick winding starts, the speed is gradually accelerated at the beginning to reach approximately 600 x speed near the center of the tape, and when the tape is close to the end, it decelerates to approximately 150 x speed or less. When the leader tape at the end of the tape is detected, the tape is completely stopped by braking controlled by the reel motor. This method shortens the quick winding time from 45 to 60 seconds for 120 minutes tape to approximately 19 to 23 seconds. In addition, since only the guide roller is in contact with the tape in the half-load state, there is almost no burden on the tape.Most DAT mechanisms based on conventional VTR technology rely only on a pair of movable tape guides that move with each loading to control the alignment of the tape with respect to the rotating head (lateral tilt / height / forward / backward tilt). Therefore, accuracy is not achieved, and the amount of error correction increases, resulting in poor sound quality. The Nakamichi1000 uses a unique stationary tape guide to solve this problem.The stationary tape guide is fixed on the opposite side of the tape from the conventional movable guide. The four built-in guides always provide accurate alignment to the tape just by pressing the tape. It is also made of graphite engineering plastic, which is highly accurate, slippery and abrasion resistant. The tape alignment is guaranteed to the micron order accuracy without requiring difficult adjustment or maintenance.FAST also pursues the quietness of tape travel and uses traditional Nakamichi technology to achieve extremely quiet operation.First of all, we have greatly reduced the tape tapping sound caused by the rotating head by making a unique design of the head shape. Second, we effectively absorb the surface vibration of the tape by taking advantage of the large internal loss of the stationary tape guide fixed to the left and right sides of the head drum. In addition, unnecessary resonance is completely damped by a high-rigidity chassis without a notch hole for the loading arm and a heavy weight head block made of die-cast, so that the tape running sound is suppressed to a level that is almost inaudible.The head section is a 4-head system with two dedicated high-precision recording and playback heads arranged at 90 ?? each.In addition, the development of an ultrahigh-speed digital muting network that effectively blocks noise when switching between tape and source has enabled smooth after-monitoring like analog, which was difficult with conventional digital recorders.It is equipped with a display window showing the movement of the cassette tape and loading arm, and accurate recording is possible while confirming the actual movement.A plug-in unit system is adopted in which most parts other than the case, power supply part and operation part can be replaced.Equipped with an absolute time system, you can use a variety of tape play functions unique to DAT.The power supply section uses the highest grade toroidal transformer.It also uses a large capacity multi-power supply with a discrete regulator.It adopts a resonance braking structure combining a heavy aluminum shell and a copper plated chassis.Uses a full static indicator that does not worry about noise generation.Equipped with a 2-speed digital auto-fader.It supports subcode functions such as absolute time search, program search, counter search, auto - manual start ID, skip ID, rehearsal function, end mark function, program number, program renumber, program memory, etc.Equipped with a 4-mode tape counter that can display counter, absolute time, remaining time and program time.Equipped with a timer standby function.Direct play is possible.Equipped with tape end repeat, end mark repeat and program repeat functions.Equipped with auto rewind and rewind auto play function.It is equipped with remote input / output terminal which realizes synchronous operation by multiple 1000.Contains coaxial and optical digital input / output terminals.Equipped with tape compartment illumination.Two optical (single crystal quartz fiber) and two coaxial (LC-OFC Class 1) digital cables are included.Comes with an aluminum window panel for replacement.Remote Controller 1000r is included.The 1000r has the same layout as the operation panel of the Nakamichi1000, and eliminates the sense of discomfort in remote operation. In addition, the 1000r has most of the functions of the 1000 and can operate up to two 1000 independently.Plus, when you order, you can choose between wired and wireless depending on what you're using.There was a 1000 Professional (business model) with the exact same contents except for some specifications.

sections.title: NAKAMICHI SOUNDSPACE5
sections.overview: A SoundSpace music system that aims for audio that subtly blends into the living space.The SoundSpace5 can be installed on a desk or shelf at an angle of about 10 degrees, and can also be mounted on a wall with a mounting hole in the back.The front panel of the main unit is made of aluminum and clear acrylic and is designed to be illuminated with blue or green light.The speakers are also made of aluminum panels and come with 3 types of speaker grills to choose from 3 colors of charcoal gray / blue / green to suit your interior.The main unit is equipped with a 3-string music bank CD changer, an FM/AM tuner and a preamplifier.The CD changer mechanism uses a unique Nakamichi system that does not use a magazine. It provides the same operating feeling as a single-disc CD player and safety loading that does not damage the disc.It is also equipped with playback functions such as all-disc memory play, random play, all-repeat and memory repeat of up to 50 songs.The FM/AM tuner uses a quartz synthesizer system can store a total of 30 preset memories (20 FM stations and 10 AM stations). It is also equipped with functions such as preset scanning and seek tuning.Each speaker is an active type with its own built-in power amplifier.The unit has a 10-cm cone woofer in the low range and a 2.5 cm dome tweeter in the high range. These units originated in Shinkai for this system and make it possible to reproduce excellent stereo images by matching the characteristics of the amplifier and the speaker unit. In particular, by matching the phase characteristics (time lag) of each frequency of the music signal, excellent sound quality is achieved.Equipped with an optical digital output terminal that can be connected to digital sound recording devices such as MD recorders.This jack can only output CD sound.Equipped with an RCA output terminal and a subwoofer output terminal that can be output to a cassette deck, etc.An auxiliary input terminal is also provided.Equipped with tone control function, Bass/Mid/Treble can be adjusted.It also has a loudness control.Equipped with a sleep timer function.It has a headphone port.It comes with 2 types of remote control, main remote control and sub remote control.

sections.title: NAKAMICHI ST-70
sections.overview:
138,000 (around 1987)  130,000 (around 1989)

FM/AM tuner equipped with Schott NR system.In order to improve reception performance in weak electric fields, a unique Schutz NR system is installed.In FM broadcasting, there is usually a kind of masking effect. When the volume of the high-frequency component in the broadcast content is larger than the noise, the noise is masked and cannot be heard. When the high-frequency component is less than the noise, the noise can be heard. The Schutz NR system takes full advantage of this masking effect, reducing the noise by changing the amount of blending according to the amount of the high-frequency component in the broadcast content. When there is enough high-frequency energy to mask the noise during the broadcast, there is no blending operation and the channel separation is widened to maintain an accurate stereo image.This circuit operates between 19 dBf and 53 dBf in signal strength, passes the circuit to maximize channel separation at a signal strength of 53 dBf or higher, and performs normal high-blend operation when signal strength is less than 19 dBf.The Shotts NR system improves the effective stereo sensitivity by 9 dB while maintaining the stereo image as much as possible, and expands the stereo reception area by approximately 8 times (approximately 2.8 times in distance).The front-end section uses a twin varicap diode for 6-train front-end to improve RF intermodulation characteristics and achieve high interference rejection capability. The RF amplifier circuit and mixer circuit use a dual-gate MOS FET to ensure excellent linearity, S/N and distortion factor.The PLL circuit, which is important in the quartz synthesizer method, employs a pulse swallow method in which the reference oscillation frequency is set to 25 kHz outside the audible band, eliminating the problem of residual noise at the reference frequency.In addition, the digital control signal transmission of the synthesizer employs a full static control method in which only one signal is carried on one signal line, thereby suppressing the deterioration of the S/N ratio.The IF section supports two stage switching of the IF band.In the wide position, a four stage linear phase ceramic filter with excellent group delay characteristics is used. In addition, when there is a large amount of interference from neighboring stations, it to the narrow position provides sharp selectivity with three stages of narrow band + two stages of linear phase.The limiter amplifier section consists of an FET input and a 3-stage Darlington differential IC, which provides high gain, wide dynamic range and high S/N ratio.In the AM tuner section, the mixer circuit of the RF-amplifier section is double-balanced so that good reception can be obtained when Tsutomu Dainyu is in use.In addition, we have adopted an automatic gain control (AGC) circuit that lowers the sensitivity of the RF amplifier section to keep the gain constant when the input radio wave exceeds a certain level, improving the RF intermodulation characteristics.A total of 16 FM/AM random preset memories are installed.Equipped with a 5-segment signal meter.This meter can be switched to a multi-path meter.The auto-seek (auto-tuning) level can be switched between approximately 40 dBf and approximately 20 dBf.Manual tuning is possible using the rotary knob.In addition, it is equipped with an FM muting ON/OFF switch and an FM mode (stereo / mono) switch so that it can receive broadcasting stations with extremely weak radio waves.Equipped with an output level adjustment volume.Equipped with Last One Memory which stores the broadcasting station just before turning off the power.When combined with the CA-70 control amplifier, the ST-70 can be operated with the CA-70 remote controller.

sections.title: NAKAMICHI 430
sections.overview: 400 series FM stereo tuner.With an emphasis on the selection characteristics of the tuning circuit, we have adopted a frequency straight-line 5-row variable capacitor.The spurious interference ratio is increased to 100 dB by two RF stages and multi-stage tuning.A low-noise dual-gate MOS FET is used for the high-frequency amplifier stage. The 3-stage configuration improves quieting sensitivity by 50 dB and reduces distortion. This suppresses high-order harmonic distortion and enhances the ability to eliminate cross-modulation interference and intermodulation interference.In the IF stage of a common tuner, two or three stage ceramic filters are used to improve the selectivity characteristics. However, although the selectivity characteristics are improved, the group delay time characteristics become rippled and distortion increases. Even if the filter is selected well, the distortion cannot be prevented from increasing at low modulation levels, and the characteristics cannot be prevented from deteriorating at low sound volumes. In addition, the temperature characteristics of each filter stage vary.For these reasons, only one stage of 4-element one wafer concentrated ceramic filter specially selected for 430 is used, and it is composed of two stages including one stage of LC linear phase filter.As a result, the advantages of two filters, ceramic and LC, are fully utilized, and both selectivity characteristics and group delay characteristics, which are mutually contradictory, are compatible with excellent numerical values.Equipped with a 2-stage bandwidth switching mechanism, two stages of normal and narrow can be selected.It is equipped with SLT (self-lock tuning) circuit to eliminate tuning deviation.In the local oscillator circuit, a high frequency of 10.7 MHz lower than the receiving frequency is generated and sent to the mixing circuit. Then, by subtracting the local oscillation frequency from the receiving frequency in the mixing circuit, an intermediate frequency of 10.7 MHz is obtained. When the local oscillation frequency drifts due to temperature or other effects, the tuning point itself deviates.The SLT detects the DC component of the detection output and forcibly corrects the drift of the local oscillation frequency when the tuning error occurs. This is effective enough that the tuning indicator does not turn off even if the dial knob is artificially moved by 200 kHz once the tuning is done.A PLL circuit is used for the MPX circuit.When the MPX signal generated in the tuner is out of phase due to heat or humidity, the PLL circuit detects this phase shift and corrects it so that it is always in phase, thus obtaining stable separation characteristics.The muting circuit uses a unique noise level detection method muting circuit.In conventional muting circuits, the muting operating point was determined by the antenna input level, but with this method, even relatively weak broadcast signal input tended to be muted.By detecting the noise level, even a very small amount of broadcast signal input can be reliably received as long as the SN ratio is guaranteed.Equipped with a high blend switch.This function eliminates noise by adding the high frequencies of the left and right channels, which have noticeable noise components, and reduces the noise of the weak electric field input.Dolby FM decode circuit can be mounted.Digital tuning method is adopted.If both the left and right tuning indicators of the dial indicator light up, the correct tuning point and the reception frequency are locked by SLT.The signal indicator shows an input signal and lights up at approximately 55 dBf (300 ? V, 300  ), indicating that S/N and distortion factor are sufficient.There was a wood cabinet for the 400 series as an option sold separately.

sections.title: NAKAMICHI AMPLIFIER1
sections.overview: This is an integrated amplifier with a focus on sound quality, with harmonic time alignment technology at the core.The Harmonic Time Alignment Theory was developed by Steve Kalison of the Nakamichi US Research Center as a result of many years of research focusing on the characteristics of NFB itself. It directly addresses the timing of the fundamental sound and the distortion component and the action of NFB.The Amplifier1 uses a newly developed amplifier circuit based on this theory for both the preamplifier and power amplifier sections. This circuit uses a wide-band, low-gain open-loop design to keep the amount of NFB in the audio band constant and to minimize the amount of NFB itself. This circuit combines techniques to correctly adjust the phases of the fundamental sound and distortion components over the entire audio band.The line amplifier section is composed of discrete elements so that high-quality sound devices can be installed.As a result, high-quality parts which cannot be used in IC configuration can be used everywhere, and the frequency characteristics of the open-loop gain can be kept constant.We also use a main volume driven by a motor drive, a motor drive rotary selector, and an electrolytic capacitor with an emphasis on sound quality.The power amplifier section uses a total of 8 transistors with 2 parallel drives, and has a current supply capability of peak current 28A.It uses a multi-regulated power supply system to prevent interference between sections and stages around the power supply. The Amplifier1 in particular has separate transformer windings for the preamp section, power amplifier section and control section, and separate local regulators for the equalizer amplifier and line amplifier.The ground circuit also uses Nakamichi's original isolated ground system to reduce noise interference to the signal system.Equipped with a high-gain equalizer amplifier with a transistor differential input.Equipped with CD direct input, signal input from here jumps selector and balance volume, and simple signal transmission is possible by passing through dedicated 4-connected volume.Equipped with tone control and muting circuit.It comes with a remote control that can adjust volume, switch input, and operate Nakamichi CD player and deck.The following are sold separately : signal converter RC-4 used for system remote connection between Amplifier series and remote control deck such as CR-70/CR-50/CR-40/CR-30/CR-20/DRAGON, SRC-2 used for system remote connection between second Casettedeck1/Casettedeck2/Nakamichi1000, and exclusive cable SRC-3 used for system remote connection between Nakamichi1000/1000II/700/700II and Amplifier series.

sections.overview: Based on Nakamichi's technology, this integrated amplifier seeks sound and taste comparable to high-grade separate amplifiers.The preamp section and power amplifier section use a harmonic time alignment amplifier, a circuit technology unique to Nakamichi.This circuit is a technology that focuses on the time lag between the music signal and the distortion component brought about by the extensive use of NFB. sections.title: NAKAMICHI 410
sections.overview: A control amplifier with improved distortion characteristics and SN ratio.In the 410, new ideas were pursued for the basic circuit structure, and a special circuit called a triple transistor circuit was devised and adopted for the first stage circuit to improve the SN ratio.This circuit focuses on the problem of the thermal noise en generated by the base input resistance hie. In an actual circuit, the source impedance Rs is added to hie in series. In this case, the value of Rs is larger than that of hie, and the thermal noise generated by Rs is often larger than that of hie, so the value of en tends to be ignored. However, when Rs is very small, such as in MC cartridges, the effect of hie on the SN ratio is large. Therefore, the hie is suppressed to 1 / 3 and the en is reduced to 1 /   3 by a triple transistor circuit.In addition, the SN ratio has been improved by approximately 10 dB by adopting a transistor with less current noise in.Both the first and second stages are made of common-emitter amplifier, and the output stage is made of a class A complimentary service push-pull circuit.A differential amplifier is often used as a pre-amplifier because it is easy to construct an NF circuit. However, since the internal resistance of the differential transistor causes non-linear distortion at low volume and noise build-up, a buffer amplifier is used for the 410. This is based on the idea that the characteristics at low output power are more important than those at maximum output power.In a differential amplifier, the differential transistor outside the NF loop has an internal resistance Ri. Since this Ri varies depending on the level, nonlinear distortion occurs when Ri becomes larger than the resistance inside the NF loop at a low volume. In a circuit of 410, the differential transistor can be assumed to be removed, and Ri becomes 0 so that the playback sound is not affected by the level change.Noise and distortion are reduced by using luxurious parts such as metallic film resistors and high-precision capacitors, which are more expensive than transistors, 3mm-thick tinning copper plates for input / output pin jack boards, and epoxy-based plastic for printed circuit boards.In addition, the part layout is also very low in the influence of the flux by taking advantage of many years of experience.A power transformer using a toroidal oriented core is adopted to reduce leakage to the outside.A level in which no magnetic flux leakage is detected at 410 measurement has been achieved.The tone control circuit and the amplifier circuit are completely independent on separate boards and operate only when the tone switch is pressed. This realizes both the completeness of a flat amplifier and a practical device.Equipped with a subsonic filter.Equipped with a phono input sensitivity selector switch, it can be adjusted to the output of the cartridge.Impedance is 100k   constant, and direct connection of MC cartridge is also possible.Equipped with contour volume as a loudness function.Unlike general loudness, this method automatically changes the compensation amount of frequency balance as the volume is reduced.High-precision detent volume is used for volume.This volume has 22 contacts and 2 dB steps with a left / right error of 0.5 dB, so that the left / right balance does not become noticeable at low volume.

sections.title: NAKAMICHI CA-50II
sections.overview:
210,000 (around 1987)  200,000 (around 1989)

An improved control amplifier based on the CA-50 and incorporating the technology obtained in the development of the CA-70.The MC head amplifier uses a parallel push-pull input configuration with super Hi-gm FET to reduce noise level.In addition, the resistance value of the signal system is minimized to ensure a good S/N ratio.The equalizer amplifier and line amplifier have a two stage differential amplifier configuration with a dual FET differential input at the first stage and a bipolar transistor differential input at the second stage. The final buffer has a sufficient current supply capability as an emitter follower with a current bootstrap to maintain high linearity against impedance drops in the high-frequency range.The emitter follower with current bootstrap has a simple structure and high current supply capability. Moreover, it maintains full Class-A operation. This circuit ensures high linearity in actual operation against the stray capacitance in the later stage and stable current supply against load impedance fluctuations.It is equipped with tone control that takes into consideration the effect on sound quality by minimizing the amount of change.A multi-regulated power supply is adopted for the power supply section, and mutual interference due to voltage fluctuations between amplifiers is eliminated by making the power supply voltage constant in two stages. In addition, ground interference is eliminated by an isolated ground system that incorporates an FET buffer into the power supply line.In order to make the signal flow as simple and straight as possible, we have adopted a crossbar twin-type relay that is directly connected to the input terminal for switching the program source. The audio circuit has an L/R twin-mono structure to ensure excellent channel separation.In addition, the front / bottom chassis is made of copper-plated chassis, and the structure of the aluminum chassis has been made more rigid to improve vibration resistance, preventing adverse effects of magnetic flux and external vibration.Carbon resistors and film capacitors developed exclusively for audio are actively used, and gold contacts are used for the cartridge selector and MC gain / MM load capacity selector switches.In addition, we use many parts with excellent characteristics and audibility, such as a toroidal transformer for the power supply, a oxygen-free copper wire with low transmission loss for the wiring material for the signal system, and a oxygen-free copper pattern bonded to an epoxy board for the printed board.Load capacity in MM position (100pF/200pF/300pF) and gain in MC position (36dB/30dB/24dB) can be selected.In addition, the load resistance at the MC position can be adjusted from 100   to 50   / 30   / 20   / 10   / 3   (by service center or dealer).Equipped with mutual dubbing function of the tape deck.Uses gold-plated input / output terminals.The power cord uses a very thick power cord with polarity indication.Remote power ON/OFF control terminal is mounted, and power operation of combined equipment can be linked with CA-50II by using SPC-1J sold separately.

sections.title: NAKAMICHI CA-70
sections.overview:
400,000 (around 1987)  380,000 (around 1989)

A control amplifier designed to simplify the amplifier circuit without compromising sound quality.To achieve pure signal transmission with a simple circuit configuration without relying on a large amount of NFB, each section uses a low-noise FET at the input stage and the final stage consists of a simple emitter follower with a current bootstrap with a large current supply capability.In addition, high-precision discrete parts are used except for the DC servo, and all stages are DC amplifiers to achieve both high linearity and simplicity.The MC head amplifier uses a parallel push-pull input configuration based on ultra-Hi-DC gmFET instead of conventional differential input, which is difficult to achieve low noise. In addition, the MC head amplifier has an excellent S/N ratio by minimizing the signal resistance.In addition, a five parallel push-pull input configuration per one channel, an output stage with an emitter-follower with a current bootstrap is adopted, and a transformer winding dedicated to the MC head amplifier section is installed to eliminate interference from other circuits.The equalizer amplifier and line amplifier section take advantage of the linearity of the differential amplifier and adopt a two stage differential amplifier configuration in which the first stage is differential input by dual FET and the second stage is differential amplified by bipolar transistor to enhance the bare characteristics.In addition, the emitter follower with current bootstrap at the last stage supplies sufficient current even when the load impedance fluctuates. Therefore, high linearity is maintained even when high-frequency impedance drops due to the influence of the connection cable to the RIAA element or power amplifier, and high-precision signal transmission is possible.The last stage of each amplifier section employs an emitter follower with a current bootstrap, which is simpler than the conventional cascade connection but provides a high current. This circuit provides a high current while maintaining full class A operation.A multi-regulated power supply system and an integrated ground system are used in the power supply section to eliminate mutual interference between circuits.The multi-regulated power supply has a unique structure with a two stage regulator.First, the power transformer windings and rectifiers are separated into two types, one for the equalizer amplifier / line amplifier and the other for the MC head amplifier. The power supply is first regulated by the master power regulator and then regulated again by the local power regulator installed for each L/R channel of the MC head amplifier, equalizer amplifier and line amplifier. Then, the power supply is supplied to each amplifier section.This structure prevents voltage fluctuations caused by the operation of one amplifier section from adversely affecting other amplifier sections.In the opposed ground method, a buffer with an FET is incorporated in the power supply line. The current used to flow from + ? ground ? - in a general amplifier is directly passed from + to -. Thus, the ground only functions to provide an accurate reference potential to the amplifier, and any mutual interference around the ground is eliminated.It is equipped with AFT (Acoustic Fine Tuning), a newly developed sound field correction system that suppresses quality degradation.The AFT can be adjusted within   5 dB in 0.5 dB steps at three points : Low (25 Hz), Mid (250 Hz), and High (30 kHz), so that the response is close to a flat response.In order to minimize the effect on sound quality, AFT does not use general volume but consists of a highly reliable 21-step rotary switch, metal film resistor, film capacitor, low-noise FET, and transistor discrete configuration.To switch the program source, a crossbar twin-type relay with the input terminal installed at the shortest distance is adopted, making the signal flow simple and straight.In addition, the internal construction is L/R twin mono structure, and excellent separation characteristics are secured by eliminating the interference of the left and right channels.Thorough measures are taken to separate the logic and amplifier systems.First, in order to prevent the microprocessor clock noise from contaminating the music signal, ten types of photocouplers are inserted between the relay part and the logic circuit to electrically isolate the logic circuit and relay.There are also 30 types of photocouplers between the system remote control terminal and the microprocessor to prevent interference caused by electrical connection of the ground line due to pin cords of other components connected to the CA-70 or remote control cables.In addition, the logic parts and power supply parts are completely sealed in an aluminum shielded room, and aluminum panels are used extensively to ensure complete shielding.The volume resistor uses a high precision detent type to eliminate channel interference within the volume unit.In addition, to enable volume adjustment by wireless remote control, we have developed a method unique to Nakamichi to solve the disadvantages of the general motor drive method. In this method, a sufficient distance is provided between the motor and the volume resistor, and the shaft of the knob is separated from the shaft of the resistor. The shafts are connected with a special flexible joint to shut out the influence of motor noise and vibration and to absorb external vibration.The balance volume consists of 10 discrete metal film resistors for each channel, and this resistor network is switched by a rotary switch of 21 clicks and 0.5 dB steps.As for the parts, we use carefully selected ones that are easy to hear and have no unbalanced habit as much as possible.We use ultra-Hi-gm FET for the MC head amplifier and FET with the same characteristics for the equalizer amplifier / line amplifier. For passive elements, we use metal film resistor, brass gold plated cap / carbon mold resistor, high-quality film compound wound capacitor, etc.The power supply consists of an amplifier system and a logic system, each of which is equipped with a dedicated transformer. A toroidal transformer with less leakage flux is adopted for each of them.The cartridge selector on the rear panel allows you to select MM/MC, load capacity in the MM position (100pF/200pF/300pF), and gain in the MC position (36dB/30dB/24dB). In addition, the load resistance in the MC position is fixed to 100   at the time of shipment from the factory, but can be adjusted to 50   / 30   / 20   / 10   / 3   by inserting the supplied high-precision carbon resistance.Audio mute is installed.Equipped with two types of tape recording / playback terminals capable of mutual dubbing.It has a gold-plated input / output terminal with low aging and high conductivity.A very thick power cord using oxygen-free copper wire with polarity indication is used.Wireless remote control is included.In addition, it can be controlled from another room by using the optional remote sensor RS-7.

sections.title: NAKAMICHI 630
sections.overview: This 600 series FM tuner preamplifier combines the functions of an FM tuner and a control amplifier.Amplifier sectionThe preamp section of the 630 inherits almost the same circuit and performance of the 610.The basic circuit configuration uses a triple transistor circuit.This circuit focuses on the problem of the thermal noise en caused by the base input resistance hie of the transistor. In an actual circuit, the source impedance Rs is added to hie in series. In this case, the value of Rs is larger than hie, so the thermal noise generated by Rs is often larger than hie. Therefore, the value of en tends to be ignored. However, the effect of hie on the signal-to-noise ratio is large when Rs is very small, such as MC-type cartridges.To solve this problem, we have adopted a triple transistor circuit that reduces the hie by one third and the en by one third. Furthermore, we have improved the S / N ratio by approximately 10 dB by adopting a transistor with less current noise in.Both the first stage and the second stage are common-emitter amplifiers, and a complimentary service class A push-pull circuit is used for the output stage. Usually, a differential amplifier is used because it is easy to construct an NF circuit for a preamplifier. However, a buffer amplifier is used for all preamps to avoid non-linear distortion due to the internal resistance of the differential transistor at low volume and noise accumulation.In a differential amplifier, the differential transistor outside the NF loop has an internal resistance Ri. This resistance Ri varies with the level. Nonlinear distortion occurs when Ri becomes larger than the resistance inside the NF loop at a low volume. In a circuit of 630, the differential transistor can be assumed to be removed, and Ri becomes 0 so that the playback sound is not affected by the level change.Equipped with a high output headphone amplifier.When inserted into the headphone jack, the pre-out output is automatically cut.Metal film resistors and high-precision capacitors, which are more expensive than transistors, are frequently used, and all printed circuit boards are made of epoxy plastic.In addition, the part layout has been made to have very little effect of flux by taking advantage of the experience accumulated over 10 years ago.Equipped with a phono input sensitivity selector switch, 3-step switching is possible so that it can be adjusted to the output of the cartridge.Impedance is 100k   constant and direct connection of MC type cartridge is also possible.Equipped with two types of tape monitor and dubbing switch.Equipped with contour volume as a loudness function.This circuit differs from conventional ones in that the compensation amount of frequency balance is automatically changed as the volume is reduced.FM tuner sectionThe IF stage employs a 2-step switching of selectivity, which can be switched according to the reception condition.A 12-element LC filter is used lc filter is used, but by integrating 6 elements into one pack, the reduction in distortion rate is effectively limited to two stages of filter. normal positionIn the narrow band, a four element ceramic filter with excellent spurious characteristics is made into one element on one wafer, and combined with two stages of LC linear phase filter to make a three stage configuration. Moreover, one pack is made into an IC-like shipping system that mutually cancels the influence of thermal characteristics, characteristic differences of elements, and disturbance.The front-end section employs a frequency-linear 5-row variable capacitor developed exclusively for FM. This improves the selection characteristics by multi-stage tuning and suppresses gain deviation by adopting a triple-tune configuration.For RF amplification, a low-noise dual-gate MOS-FET is used. Because of its low distortion, high-order harmonic generation is suppressed, and it has excellent ability to eliminate intermodulation interference and intermodulation interference. Because of its low-noise element, it also has sufficient practical sensitivity.The front end part is grounded on a metal plate at the shortest distance to prevent the leakage of local oscillation frequency and other interference. The metal plate has a temperature coefficient several times higher than that of printed circuit boards, which prevents various types of drift.In addition, the front end, RF-stage and IF-stage are completely shielded by 1 mm thick tinning steel plates to prevent spurious generation due to beat interference caused by clips.Digital tuning method is adopted for tuning method.When the left lamp of the tuning indicator at the top of the tuning dial lights up, it indicates that the tuning point is shifted to the right. When the right lamp lights up, it indicates that the tuning point is shifted to the left. When the center lamp lights up, it is an accurate tuning point.In addition, this lamp also serves as an indicator of the input level of radio waves. It lights up at approximately 30 dBf (17 ? V300  ), and the signal indicator shows the strength of the input level of radio waves. It operates at approximately 55 dBf (300 ? V300  ). When it lights up, S/N and distortion factor are guaranteed.In this tuning operation, the lighting level is narrowed with a sharp range of 25 kHz selectivity, and once tuned, the range is widened to 50 kHz width to absorb slight tuning drift and improve sound quality.A PLL circuit is used in the MPX section.As a result, the phase shift of the MPX signal generated inside the tuner due to the influence of heat and humidity is detected, and the phase is corrected so that it is always in the same phase, resulting in stable separation.It is equipped with a muting mechanism to eliminate inter-station noise during channel selection.Muting is linked with the tuning indicator logic and is released when the red light in the center comes on.Equipped with an MPX filter that cuts the 19 khz pilot signal.Conventional filters tend to cut down to the audible frequency band around 15 kHz, resulting in poor sound quality. Therefore, in the 630, we devised and adopted a filter with a unique attenuation curve that provides a sharp attenuation curve from 18 kHz.At 19 kHz, the attenuation is -70dB and the distortion is 0.03% or less, reducing the effect on the original frequency characteristics of FM broadcast waves.To support Dolby FM broadcasting, a Dolby FM decoding circuit is mounted.There was a special rack for 600 series as an option sold separately.This rack is specifically designed for the 600 series and can be used to mount the configuration of your choice.

sections.title: NAKAMICHI 620
sections.overview: A 600 series stereo power amplifier.A newly developed complete mirrored push-pull circuit is used for the circuit configuration.The first stage of this circuit is a current mirror load differential, but the output stage has been modified. The first two stage transistors and the second two stage transistors are combined with transistors with opposite characteristics. The plus and minus sides are also symmetrical. It is named Complete Mirror because it has a structure that looks like a mirror.It is generally believed that the characteristics of NPN and PNP transistors are symmetrical. However, this is not the case. N-type and P-type transistors have slightly different characteristics because they are produced by different manufacturing methods depending on the addition of a small amount of impurity element. This causes crossover distortion and switching distortion when the amplified positive and negative waves are connected. To solve this problem, the CompleteMirror configuration has been developed as a method to cancel the difference in characteristics by skillfully combining NPN and PNP in the circuit.This circuit configuration realizes a low distortion factor of 5 ppm with an output power of 100W + 100W.The complete mirrored push-pull circuit reduces the idle current by using the transistor characteristics without waste or effort.As a result, the temperature rise is small and the characteristics hardly change with time.Two 39,000 ? F capacitors and a toroidal transformer are used for the power supply.A tinning copper plate 2 mm thick and 1 cm wide is used to connect the power transformer and the capacitor. This makes the internal resistance of the wiring close to 0, eliminates the potential difference between them, and prevents noise due to ripple.A peak power indicator is embedded in the heat sink.It has two lamps, green and red. Green can be switched to 1W/5W/25W, and red can be switched to 25W/50W/MAX (110 to 130W).Lights up for 3 ms with 0.1 ms input.A protective circuit is provided at the output stage.There was a bridge adapter BA-100 as an option sold separately.Bridge connection is possible by connecting the BA-100 between the preamplifier and the two 620 s.There was a system rack for the 600 series as an option sold separately.This rack mounts the 600, 610, and 620 600 series and is equipped with digital timers.

sections.title: NAKAMICHI PA-50
sections.overview:
220,000 (around 1987)  200,000 (around 1989)

This is a low-cost stereo power amplifier that inherits the music playback capability of the PA-70.It has the same circuit configuration as the PA-70, and the power transformer and electrolytic capacitor have been changed.The STASIS circuit is used to realize the ideal of perfect speaker drive.The most important feature of the STASIS circuit is that it enables high-quality signal transmission while eliminating the overall NFB with an extremely simple circuit. Since there is no loop for returning from output to input, it is free from problems associated with the complicated behavior of speakers and realizes extremely stable operation. In addition, since the anti-oscillation coil used in general amplifiers is not required, uniform output impedance is obtained in all bands.In a power amplifier, the amplifier element must supply current according to the impedance of the speaker. Since this impedance always fluctuates during music playback, the current supply at the output stage also changes. In addition, since the voltage fluctuates depending on the level of the music signal, it is also necessary to supply current according to this voltage fluctuation. When the amount of current changes in this way, the amplification factor of the amplifier element at the output stage inevitably changes, making linear voltage amplification impossible and causing distortion. Therefore, in order to perform linear transmission without relying on feedback methods such as NFB and other distortion improvement technologies, the fluctuation of the amplification factor of the amplifier element itself must be suppressed.The STASIS circuit solves this problem by driving the speakers in parallel with a two part output stage consisting of a STASIS section that amplifies the voltage under conditions with reduced current fluctuations and a current mirror bootstrap section that supplies the current required by the speakers.The current mirror bootstrap section, which supplies current to the speakers, has a very high impedance relative to the STASIS section because it is a collector follower and has little power to control the voltage, so it has a negligible effect on the quality of the signal transmission. Instead, it promises stable operation for the inductance component of the speakers, and moreover, high current supply capability is obtained by utilizing the capability of the transistor with efficient class AB operation.In the STASI section, the total quality is controlled by operating with a small power while maintaining pure A-class operation so as to compensate for nonlinear distortion in the current mirror bootstrap section.These configurations provide an overwhelming degree of driveability to control various speakers.In order to utilize the potential of the STASIS circuit, an output stage configuration with a margin is adopted.The PA-50 uses 20 power transistors, of which two per channel are used in the STASIS section, which is the voltage amplification stage for pure class A operation, and the rest are used in the current mirror bootstrap section, which is the current supply section.This current feed section uses a high-power transistor with a Pc (collector loss) of 130W with four parallel push-pull per channel, and is connected with collector followers with low transmission loss to ensure excellent current feed capability of peak 35A.In addition, a LAPT (Multi-Emitter Power Transistor) element that boasts high-speed response is used for the transistor in order to achieve high linearity and high speed.Since the NFB is applied only slightly to the voltage amplification stage and does not have an overall loop, no output coil is required to prevent oscillation, thereby achieving a uniform output impedance in the entire audible band up to high frequencies.The power supply section uses a large 450W power transformer to improve the S/N ratio and adopt a toroidal method with less leakage flux. The transformer is surrounded by a magnetic shield made of silicon steel plate.The filter condenser has a large capacity of 94,000 ? F in total. In order to improve high-frequency impedance in particular, we use hard high-purity aluminum foil for both electrodes. In addition, solid aluminum is used for the terminals, and the connection method between the terminals and aluminum foil also takes into consideration sound quality. In addition, we use a chemical conversion method that is superior in sound quality for the oxide film, which is a dielectric, and an electrolyte that is high-speed, low-strain, and excellent in temperature stability.It uses parts that have been tested repeatedly and carefully.First, we use metal film resistors whose characteristics are extremely stable against temperature changes for all resistors whose sound quality is highly affected. We also select capacitors after careful examination of sound quality. We use film capacitors for particularly important parts. These film capacitors are made of polyester film with low induction loss. They are wound tightly at low speed with high tension to prevent wrinkles and stress. To prevent external influences, we use black epoxy in the aluminum case to provide shielding and vibration protection."Monster Special" extra-thick internal wiring cable manufactured by Monster Cable USA is used for the wiring of the signal system and power supply. In addition, the material of the protective fuse is also taken into consideration. The fuse wire is made of copper alloy with low shrinkage and the entire fuse tube is hardened with ceramic powder to prevent vibration.The binding post type is used for the gold plated speaker terminal.The input terminal is also gold-plated to prevent aging.In addition to the signal transmission circuit, the left and right sides are equipped with independent protection circuits that constantly monitor the operation status.This realizes both high current supply capability and safe operation without adversely affecting sound quality.Equipped with an inrush current limiter that protects the transformer and breaker from a large amount of current that flows when the power is ON.Uses an extremely thick oxygen-free copper power cord with polarity indication.

sections.title: NAKAMICHI PA-50CE
sections.overview: A stereo power amplifier announced as a custom edition of the PA-50.The circuit configuration is based on the STASIS method.The STASIS system consists of a STASIS circuit (pure class A operation) that maintains the steady state (STASIS) state so that the amplifying element always operates in the most linear state, and a current mirror bootstrap section (class AB operation) that only supplies current to the speakers. These circuits drive the speakers in parallel, achieving high stability and excellent drive capability while eliminating overall NFB.A total of 24 Pc130W class power transistors (STASIS section : 2 parallel, current mirror bootstrap section : 4 parallel) are used to realize high current supply capability.The output terminals of all power transistors are directly connected by gold-plated copper bus bars to equalize the impedance between each transistor and the speaker terminal.The power supply unit has a large capacity that can be easily extracted with a rated output of more than 500W/ch under normal design. By using the power supply unit half-way, the current supply capability is improved and the drive power of the speaker is increased.The power transformer adopts a special toroidal power transformer exclusively for the 470 VA Custom Edition with significantly improved regulation characteristics in actual operation. The electrolytic capacitor is equipped with a special film capacitor of 47,000 ? Fx2 exclusively for the Custom Edition with original tuning.It is also equipped with a high-speed diode bridge and inrush current limiter that boast excellent response.The chassis structure adopts a system called skeleton chassis.In this system, the transformer and condenser are mounted on a thick chassis that passes through the front and back, and a solid frame is assembled with steel angles around it.Resonance is reduced by applying a thick electrodeposition coating to all steel parts that make up the chassis.The heat sink uses a fully integrated ultra-large heat sink. The seamless structure ensures uniform temperature conditions between power transistors and increases the rigidity of the housing.In addition, a 3 mm thick aluminum top cover is used for the top cover.The AC cable, power switch and inrush current limiter are isolated from the audio section to eliminate any influence on sound quality.There are two types of output terminals : the normal binding post type and the brass machined large vise type. sections.title: NAKAMICHI PA-70
sections.overview:
380,000 (around 1987)  350,000 (around 1989)

High power stereo power amplifier equipped with STASIS circuit.The STASIS circuit is used to realize the ideal of perfect speaker drive.The most important feature of the STASIS circuit is that it enables high-quality signal transmission while eliminating the overall NFB with an extremely simple circuit. Since there is no loop for returning from output to input, it is free from problems associated with the complicated behavior of speakers and realizes extremely stable operation. In addition, since the anti-oscillation coil used in general amplifiers is not required, uniform output impedance is obtained in all bands.In a power amplifier, the amplifier element must supply current according to the impedance of the speaker. Since this impedance always fluctuates during music playback, the current supply at the output stage also changes. In addition, since the voltage fluctuates depending on the level of the music signal, it is also necessary to supply current according to this voltage fluctuation. When the amount of current changes in this way, the amplification factor of the amplifier element at the output stage inevitably changes, making linear voltage amplification impossible and causing distortion. Therefore, in order to perform linear transmission without relying on feedback methods such as NFB and other distortion improvement technologies, the fluctuation of the amplification factor of the amplifier element itself must be suppressed.The STASIS circuit solves this problem by driving the speakers in parallel with a two part output stage consisting of a STASIS section that amplifies the voltage under conditions with reduced current fluctuations and a current mirror bootstrap section that supplies the current required by the speakers.The current mirror bootstrap section, which supplies current to the speakers, has a very high impedance relative to the STASIS section because it is a collector follower and has little power to control the voltage, so it has a negligible effect on the quality of the signal transmission. Instead, it promises stable operation for the inductance component of the speakers, and moreover, high current supply capability is obtained by utilizing the capability of the transistor with efficient class AB operation.In the STASI section, the total quality is controlled by operating with a small power while maintaining pure A-class operation so as to compensate for nonlinear distortion in the current mirror bootstrap section.These configurations provide an overwhelming degree of driveability to control various speakers.In order to utilize the potential of the STASIS circuit, an output stage configuration with a margin is adopted.The PA-70 uses 32 power transistors, of which two per channel are used in the STASIS section, which is a voltage amplification stage for pure class A operation, and the rest are used in the current mirror bootstrap section, which is the current supply section.This current feed section uses a high-power transistor with a Pc (collector loss) of 130W with 7 parallel push-pull per channel, and is connected with collector followers with low transmission loss to ensure excellent current feed capability of 50A peak.In addition, a LAPT (Multi-Emitter Power Transistor) element that boasts high-speed response is used for the transistor in order to achieve high linearity and high speed.Since the NFB is applied only slightly to the voltage amplification stage and does not have an overall loop, no output coil is required to prevent oscillation, thereby achieving a uniform output impedance in the entire audible band up to high frequencies.The power supply section uses a large 700W power transformer to improve the S/N ratio and adopt a toroidal method with less leakage flux. The transformer is surrounded by a magnetic shield made of silicon steel plate.The filter condenser has a large capacity of 132,000 ? F in total. In order to improve high-frequency impedance in particular, we use hard high-purity aluminum foil for both electrodes. In addition, solid aluminum is used for the terminals, and the connection method between the terminals and aluminum foil also takes into consideration sound quality. In addition, we use a chemical conversion method that is superior in sound quality for the oxide film, which is a dielectric, and an electrolyte that is high-speed, low-strain, and excellent in temperature stability.It uses parts that have been tested repeatedly and carefully.First, we use metal film resistors whose characteristics are extremely stable against temperature changes for all resistors whose sound quality is highly affected. We also select capacitors after careful examination of sound quality. We use film capacitors for particularly important parts. These film capacitors are made of polyester film with low induction loss. They are wound tightly at low speed with high tension to prevent wrinkles and stress. To prevent external influences, we use black epoxy in the aluminum case to provide shielding and vibration protection."Monster Special" extra-thick internal wiring cable manufactured by Monster Cable USA is used for the wiring of the signal system and power supply. In addition, the material of the protective fuse is also taken into consideration. The fuse wire is made of copper alloy with low shrinkage and the entire fuse tube is hardened with ceramic powder to prevent vibration.The binding post type is used for the gold plated speaker terminal.The input terminal is also gold-plated to prevent aging.In addition to the signal transmission circuit, the left and right sides are equipped with independent protection circuits that constantly monitor the operation status.This realizes both high current supply capability and safe operation without adversely affecting sound quality.Equipped with an inrush current limiter that protects the transformer and breaker from a large amount of current that flows when the power is ON.Uses an extremely thick oxygen-free copper power cord with polarity indication.
