sections.title: NAKAMICHI DRAGON-CT
sections.overview:
A record player that takes measures against record eccentricity by means of an absolute center search mechanism.

In the DRAGON-CT, attention is paid to the eccentricity of the record board, and attention is paid to the deterioration of sound quality when the absolute center between the center hole of the record and the sound groove is shifted, and a unique absolute center search mechanism is installed.When a record is off-center, the tone arm swings left and right by the amount of eccentricity, and the cantilever is largely twisted with respect to the sound groove of the micron unit. This causes the cantilever to trace out of its center of operation, causing a phase shift between the left and right channels, which impairs sound image localization, sound transparency, and sound field reproducibility.The absolute center search mechanism detects the amount of eccentricity when the record is set, and moves the upper side of the double-structured turntable by the amount of eccentricity, so that the center of rotation of the turntable and the absolute center of the sound groove of the record match with high precision.In the absolute route center search mechanism, the eccentricity is detected by the sensor arm.When the start switch of the Absolute Center Search is pressed, the sensor arm is automatically lead-in to the final sound groove of the r-home electronic drive, and the amount of eccentricity is detected from the left-to-right vibration of the sensor arm due to eccentricity. At this time, the magnitude of the vibration of the sensor arm is optically detected, replaced by A/D converted, and the microcomputer calculates the average value to determine the amount of eccentricity.Then, based on the data obtained from the sensor arm, the turntable is stopped with the sensor arm swung to the innermost position. At this time, the rotation angle is detected by the slit carved in the lower part of the circumference of the turntable, and the turntable stops with high precision.When the turntable stops, the center search rod in the strobe housing is activated and comes into contact with the center search turntable and starts pushing it. The center search rod is in a straight line connecting the motor spindle and the needle tip of the sensor arm. The sensor arm moves outward by the pushing distance.The adjustment is completed when the sensor arm has been moved outward by the amount of eccentricity. Then, the turntable starts rotating again, the sensor arm returns after confirming that the sensor arm is no longer swung, and the eccentricity correction is completed.With the Absolute Center Search mechanism, the center hole of the record is slightly out of the normal setting position (nominal center), and the Absolute Center is set directly above the motor spindle. The corrected eccentricity is limited to 20 microns or less, but this value is such that the sound quality degradation due to eccentricity is not felt.The turntable drive motor uses Nakamichi's unique super linear torque DD motor.In order to prevent this problem, the Super Linear Torque DD motor employs a method in which the rotor magnet is specially magnetized so that the magnetic flux change from the S pole to the N pole becomes a sine wave. In addition, the current switching to the drive coil also becomes a sine wave, and two pairs of sine wave torques that are magnetically offset by 90   are superimposed. The resulting torque is Sin. flutter2  + cos2(? +   / 2) = sin2  + cos2  = 1 and is always constant. As a result, smooth constant torque drive without cogging or uneven torque is realized in principle, and generation of flutter is suppressed from the root.The servo circuit uses a quartz PLL and FG servo system to improve rotational accuracy.Grease is injected into the small gap between the motor shaft and the bearing, and a special slit is provided in the shaft so that a uniform film surface is always formed by rotation.As a result, the pressure to the bearing is uniform, and quiet rotation is obtained and durability is improved.In the DRAGON-CT, flutter components are reduced by the super linear torque DD motor, so the turntable does not need to be extremely heavy. Therefore, the total weight of the combination of the main turntable made of aluminum die-cast, the center search turntable made of glass, and the rubber mat is 3.05 kg.In addition, the main turntable and the center search turntable are closely connected with each other through an air layer of several microns. This air layer absorbs vibrations from each other, and the squeal of the turntable is kept very low.It is equipped with a nominal center reset button. Press this button before executing the absolute center search to reset the center search turntable to the nominal center.

The tone arm employs a specially designed oil-dump-type high-rigidity straight-tone arm that focuses on the high-performance MC cartridge designed by Lomas High Complinus.The arm pipe is made of brass with high rigidity to reduce the weight of the arm tip and increase the strength at the same time. This improves the ability to follow the delicate movement of the needle tip and prevents the occurrence of partial resonance caused by variations in the strength of the arm pipe.The vertical bearing is designed so that the needle tip is always perpendicular to the sound groove even if the tone arm moves up and down due to the warping of the record.In addition, a high-precision radial ball bearing has been adopted for the horizontal bearing to increase the initial motion sensitivity in the horizontal direction and to improve the dynamic balance of the tone arm.The arm pipe is replaceable, and it can be used with various cartridges by adding the replacement tone arm pipe TA-100 as an option sold separately.A chucking joint system is used to join the arm pipe and body.The lead wire inside the pipe is made thicker, and the connector section is inserted with gold-plated split pins for surface contact as well as self-cleaning, minimizing the output loss of the cartridge.It employs an oil dump system using silicon oil, which does not change over time, and improves separation and resonance characteristics by suppressing low-frequency resonance near 5 to 10 Hz.

By adopting a double suspension system and a double-structured cabinet, the effect of vibration is reduced.The suspension part is a double suspension system combining rubber and spring insulators.Rubber insulators absorb relatively high-frequency floor vibrations, while spring insulators begin to absorb vibrations at relatively low frequencies, and extremely steep vibration damping characteristics are obtained over a completely free range in total.In addition, the topboard attached to the turntable and tone arm is floated by a slightly soft tuned spring insulator, which is damped by a rubber damper to quickly absorb unwanted vibrations of the spring itself.A unique double structure has been adopted for the cabinet.Unlike the cabinet of a general player, the DRAGON-CT is made of punching metal on all sides of the cabinet to prevent vibration of the cabinet by transmitting air vibration smoothly.The top and bottom two boards are made of particle board with a thrust plate finish that has high internal loss and is hard to resonate. The top board is attached with an iron plate from the back side to ensure sufficient synthesis, and the main drive motor and tone arm are attached to this iron plate to ensure complete integration of their movements.To prevent air vibrations picked up by the dust cover from being transmitted to the turntable and tone arm, the dust cover hinge is directly connected to the bottom board.

A semi-automatic system is used for the control part as long as it does not adversely affect the sound quality.The tone arm is an auto-return system driven by an optical switch and a dedicated coreless linear motor. Queuing and cutting are also available from the front control panel.The lifting and lowering of the arm is made smooth by the smooth arm elevator of oil dump system.Equipped with pitch control function of   6%.Needle pressure adjustment can be controlled by direct reading up to 3g in 0.1g steps.The anti-skating mechanism is also separated from the tone arm for ease of configuration.The mounting part of the rubber insulator also serves as a height adjustment mechanism, and the horizontal balance of the cabinet can be adjusted according to the installation location.Gold plated pinjack output terminal is used for the output terminal.The top and bottom boards have a black painted natural wood veneer finish.Comes with a 500g dedicated disk stabilizer that reduces the warpage of the record and improves the adherence of the turntable.

sections.title: NAKAMICHI 480Z
sections.overview: This is the second generation cassette deck of the 480 series equipped with Dolby C Type NR, bias fine adjustment mechanism and LED peak level meter.Unlike the high-end 482Z/481Z, the 480Z has a 2-head configuration.Also, there are 2 kinds of color variations, black model and silver model.As a noise reduction system, Dolby B type and C type are mounted.The Dolby Dolby C-type is basically the same as that of the B-type. The Dolby C-type amplifies and records only the low level signal in the middle and high range of which hissing is a concern from the viewpoint of audibility, and returns it to the original level at the time of playback, thereby eliminating the hissing attached to the tape. The C-type is an extension of this, and achieves a total noise reduction of up to 20 dB by receiving 10 dB each from two noise reduction processors for the high-level stage and low-level stage.Type C uses a sliding band method that varies the starting saturation according to the input level and frequency components to suppress the bleeding phenomenon. In addition, the spectral skewing circuit suppresses the recording saturation of high-frequency signals of 8 kHz or higher to prevent the degradation of autumn KARAS h-number characteristics and the modulation of low-frequency signals. The anti-frequency network circuit also suppresses the recording saturation caused by large instantaneous inputs.A 2-head configuration is -head configuration.The RP-9E SENDUST recording / reproducing head is used for the recording / reproducing head, and the core is not saturated even when a large bias current is applied, and a sharp critical zone is formed.E-8L type erase head, same as 482Z/481Z, is used. Double gap type with ferrite core with excellent high-frequency characteristics and Sendust core with high magnetic flux density at the tip provides low loss and excellent erase effect.The mechanism uses a frequency distributed double capstan system.In this system, stable tape running and head touch are obtained by the double capstan system. Moreover, by changing the diameters of the two capstan and the flywheel, overlapping of flutter cycle is avoided, and overall wow and flutter characteristics are improved.In addition, it is equipped with a tape pad lifter to prevent adverse effects due to uneven pad pressure.A DC servo motor is used as the main motor.This motor detects rotational speed rotational speed as a change in voltage and controls the rotational speed to an accurate value.A resonance damping type chassis is used for the chassis. Aluminum alloy, which has a larger damping characteristic than iron, is used, and resin is outsold to absorb microvibrations harmful to sound and prevent resonance.C-MOS logic control is adopted for the operation system.In this system, when the self-locking control button is pressed, the control circuit is activated and motor commands are issued to drive the mechanism. By using a cam driven by a motor instead of a solenoid plunger, sound at the time of operation is reduced. Damage to tape and transport is reduced by soft tape touch. In addition, temperature rise and power consumption are reduced.Logic control type soft touch button is used for the control part.It also simplifies operations and improves reliability by allowing you to move directly from rewind or fast forward to regenerating condition without having to go through the stop button.Equipped with a bias fine tuning mechanism.This takes into account the slight difference in the optimum bias value even for tapes in the same position. The 480Z adjusts the recorded and reproduced sound by repeating the recording and reproduction so that the sound becomes close to the sound quality of the original music source.The variable range of the bias current is   10% from the center click position.Equipped with a wide-range LED peak level meter for level display during recording and playback, it can display 50 dB of -40dB to + 10 dB in 16 segments.Equipped with a timer recording and playback mechanism. By using a general audio timer, it is possible to record your absence and play an alarm clock.Built-in MPX filter.Equipped with a high-output headphone port.In addition, it is equipped with a 2-level switch for headphone amplifier.Equipped with a tape start memory function.Remote Control Unit RM-100 (sold separately) can be used.

sections.title: NAKAMICHI 500
sections.overview: A two head cassette deck that uses a focused gap recording and re-recording system.A two head system is used for the head section and a focused gap (magnetic focusing system) head is used for the read / write head.Recording to the cassette does not occur at the head gap, but in the decay process of the bias flux. This range is called the critical zone, which is the effective gap of the recording head. If this critical zone is wide, delicate recording cannot be performed. In conventional heads, the gap of 1.5 microns physically becomes more than 2 microns effectively due to the processing strain of the pole piece around the gap.Starting with a re-examination of the head manufacturing process, Nakamichi developed a magnetic focusing head that removes distortion by specially processing the tip of the pole piece, thereby reducing distortion in the high-frequency range by obtaining ideal focusing.The drive motor is equipped with a pulse control DC servo motor with a built-in speed detection mechanism.Equipped with independent level controls for microphone input L/R, blend microphone L + R, and line input L/R, enabling mixing.In addition to the stereo microphone inputs L/R, there is also a blend microphone input.This allows you to add a sense of realism to your stereo recording, or to create a solo, vocal, or narration.Equipped with an independent output level control.Equipped with a 3-position tape selector, bias and equalizer can be switched independently.The tape positions are SX, EX, and Normal. The time constant is set to 70 ? s for SX and 120 ? s for EX/Normal.The Dolby System is installed as a noise reduction system.Built-in 400 Hz, 0 dB test tone.Even if the peak meter indicates 0 dB during recording, the playback output will vary depending on the sensitivity of the tape, which adversely affects the operation of the Dolby NR. The test tone is used to record a reference signal of 0 dB so that the peak meter indicates exactly 0 dB during playback.Equipped with a peak limiter function, it automatically operates when an unexpected instantaneous large input is input, and compresses the large input over 0 db to approximately 1 / 7.Equipped with a 45 dB full-range peak level meter.Although the needle movements of the conventional VU meter did not keep up with the instantaneous input, this meter accurately indicates from a saturated recording level of + 5 dB to a noise level of -40dB.Tape start memory is installed.If the counter is set to 000 and this switch is pressed, it will stop at the start point when it is rewound.

sections.overview: This is a cassette deck that can be used as a stationary deck in the room and is also suitable for live recording.A magnetic focusing type recording and reproducing head is used for the recording and reproducing head.Recording is not performed in the head gap as generally believed, but in the decay process of the bias magnetic flux. This range is called the critical zone, which is the effective gap of the recording head. With conventional heads, delicate recording cannot be performed because this critical zone is wide. Even with a physically 1.5 micron gap, the effective gap is more than 2 microns. This is caused by the deformation of the pole piece around the gap.To solve this problem, Nakamichi started by reexamining the head manufacturing process and removed distortion by specially processing the tip of the pole piece. This is called a magnetic focusing head.By this magnetic focusing method, the critical zone is ideally focused, and the high-frequency distortion is minimized.The drive section employs a newly developed duty control DC-servo motor for the 550 to reduce loss, thereby realizing high efficiency and stable rotation with less current and less wow flutter.Energy-saving design is emphasized, and 15 hours continuous recording is possible with standard (super) D Battery.Alkaline dry batteries can record data continuously for about 45 hours.Built-in DC/DC converter.This maintains a constant output voltage even when the battery voltage changes from 7 v to 14 v. A 90% efficient converter with excellent conversion characteristics is used to stabilize stable performance.The level meter uses a 45 dB full-range peak meter instead of the standard -20dB level meter.This allows for both subtle sounds that are likely to be buried in noise and roaring sounds, as well as instantaneous input, and prevents distortion due to level adjustment errors.Equipped with a tape utility indicator.When you press the button, the peak meter on the left indicates the amount of tape remaining, which is indicated as a percentage regardless of the length of the tape, such as C-60 or C-90.Battery voltage can be checked with one touch.When the button is pressed, the peak meter on the right indicates the battery voltage.It is equipped with a tape end alarm using LED, and the LED on the front panel lights when the end of the tape is near.It is also equipped with a programming timer. been improved, and the durability over 10,000 hours has been realized.In addition, the Direct Flux Erase Head has been adopted for the erase head, providing excellent erasing capability.The mechanism uses a resonance diffusion double capstan system to achieve clearer sound.By changing the diameters of the two capstans, resonance frequencies are dispersed to avoid peak overlap, and wow and flutter are reduced, and modulation noise is also greatly improved.In addition, we have adopted a resonance braking mechanism to eliminate vibration generated by motors and other rotating bodies.Consideration was given to the material and structure of the chassis, and the chassis is made mainly of aluminum, which has much higher damping characteristics than iron, and combined with resin molding to prevent harmful vibrations.The recording amplifier is a DC amplifier that is directly connected to the head and eliminates the coupling capacitor, thereby reducing the phase around in the low frequency range and realizing a low distortion factor.In addition, the linearity has been improved to raise the clipping level so that accurate recording can be performed from very small input to very large input.In addition, the recording and playback equalizer uses a double-NF circuit to minimize sound quality degradation.By eliminating the erase head between the two capstan sections, contact resistance between the tape and the head is reduced and modulation noise is reduced.In addition, the height adjustment mechanism for the tape is used to prevent the occurrence of azimuth loss by performing parallel movement by interlocking the gear.It has a transmission function so that you can easily find the beginning of the music.If you press the pause button during FF or REW, the speed will be reduced to 1/2 and the recorded sound will be heard. Although it is a recording / reproducing head, it is designed so that the core does not become saturated even when a large bias current is applied like metal tape, and a sharp critical zone is generated.The erase head is equipped with E-8L which is a double-gap erase head.This head is an improvement on the 1-turn coil direct flux elimination head adopted in 580. We pay attention to the fact that the recorded signal is modulated and the distortion increases when there is an erasure residue in the low-frequency range. We focus on ensuring the erasure rate in the low-frequency range. With an ultra-small special structure and processing technology, the erasure rate at 400 Hz is 80 dB or more even in saturated recording, and it can be sufficiently erased even with metal tape with a large holding force (Hc). There is also almost no temperature rise.Resonant diffusion type transport is adopted for the mechanism part.In general, the values indicated as wow and flutter are values without flutter components, but we consider that flutter components have a strong influence on audibility. Therefore, we are working to improve mechanical systems with the primary goal of reducing flutter even if it is not included in the specifications.The mechanism uses a frequency-distributed double capstan system. By changing the capstan diameter of the closed-loop double capstan, which holds the tape with two capstan, and by dispersing the frequencies of the wow flutter, the overlap of peaks is further suppressed, sound turbidity due to modulation of the fundamental sound is eliminated, and localization is also stabilized.A PLL servo motor is used as the drive motor, and low wow flutter is achieved by phase-locked loop control.The mechanism chassis adopts a resonance damping type chassis, and by combining aluminum with resin molded parts, which have large vibration damping characteristics, it absorbs micro vibrations generated from motors and other rotating bodies.The flywheels are machined from a round iron bar and have no dynamic or static imbalance, contributing to the improvement of the wow flutter.A DC recording amplifier is used for the recording amplifier. By eliminating the coupling capacitor connected to the head from the recording amplifier, distortion during recording is improved and phase around low frequency is prevented.Double-NF circuits are used for both recording and playback equalizers. negative feedback is applied to the capacitors of the recording and playback equalizers to reduce distortion caused by the capacitors and to improve DC stability.IC logic control is adopted in the operation part. For all operations such as Play / FF / Lw / Pause / Stop, instructions are entered into the logic circuit by pressing the soft touch button, and the mechanism is operated by the control motor.Unlike the solenoid type, which consumes a large current instantaneously, the current is stable and the tape can be contacted slowly without damaging the tape. sections.title: NAKAMICHI 581
sections.overview: A cassette deck with independent recording and playback heads and a discrete head configuration.By adopting the discrete head configuration, it is a 3-head configuration including erasing.In the 581, the line amplifier is used for both recording and reproducing, so after-monitoring is not possible. However, the test tone of 400Hz/15kHz can be read directly while recording, and calibration is easy.Frequency distributed double capstan is adopted.The closed-loop double capstan system, in which the tape is held by two capstan systems, is extremely advantageous in terms of reducing modulation noise and flutter. However, in the 580 Series, the two capstan systems are made different, avoiding overlapping of flutter peaks and improving characteristics.High-precision rotation is obtained by the PLL (Phase Locked Loop) method which detects motor rotation fluctuation and compares and controls the signal and phase of the reference signal oscillator.By combining resin-molded parts with a chassis made mainly of aluminum alloy, which has a large vibration damping property, we have reduced flutter components by absorbing harmful microvibrations generated from motors and other rotating bodies.By eliminating the coupling capacitor connected from the recording amplifier to the recording head and converting it into a direct connection and a DC connection, the distortion during recording is reduced and the phase around low frequency is prevented to improve the characteristics.A double NF circuit is used to apply a negative feedback to the capacitors of the recording and playback equalizers. This circuit reduces distortion caused by the capacitors while maintaining high DC current stability.For all operations such as PLAY, FF, REW, PAUSE and STOP, the soft touch button is pressed to input commands into the logic circuit, and the control motor operates the mechanism. sections.title: NAKAMICHI 600II
sections.overview:
Black finish :   133,000 (around 1978)Silver finish :   128,000 (around 1978)

This cassette deck is an improved version of the 600 with a newly developed superhead.The head is equipped with Nakamichi's own super head.The material used for this head is crystalloid, which has extremely high ? at both low levels and high frequencies. The curves for the magnetization and demagnetization processes are very close. It also has excellent linearity and excellent frequency and strain characteristics.In addition, the Superhead realizes narrow-gap recording. Generally, the ideal gap width for recording heads is 4 to 6 microns. In order to perform playback up to 20 kHz, a gap of 1.2 microns or less was required. Therefore, recording and playback at 20 kHz was considered impossible with conventional dual-use recording heads. We have been conducting research based on our long experience in head manufacturing, and have achieved recording and playback at 20 kHz with a 0.9 micron gap by three dimensional improvements in material processing technology.Compared with other magnetic materials, the Superhead is superior to other magnetic materials by more than 5 dB in the third harmonic distortion, superior it is also superior to other magnetic materials in the even and odd order distortion beyond the third order. It is also superior in durability and can be used for more than 10,000 hours.It is equipped with a phase correction circuit, and the phase rotation is suppressed within 30 degrees in all frequency bands.By using a printed circuit board for the internal layout and thorough use of connectors, the number of cords used is reduced to more than ten. This reduces the possibility that the sound quality deteriorates due to the induction between cords when cords are used frequently.You can record your absence by combining with a timer.Equipped with a 400Hz/0dB test signal function.This allows accurate reference signals to be recorded and played back to align the levels, thereby preventing the effects of differences in tape sensitivity.Equipped with 10kHz-8dB test signal, bias adjustment knob can be used to obtain the optimum bias value according to the type of tape.It has a headphone jack.The output power at 0 dB is 45 mW, so that even low-efficiency headphones can be monitored with sufficient volume.Uses an acrylic cover that can be easily put on and taken off.Equipped with MPX filter, 19 khz pilot signal is cut during FM air check to prevent malfunction of Dolby NR system.Equipped with a 47 dB full-range peak level meter.Unlike the VU meter, which indicates the average recording level, it can directly read the point that is close to the saturation level.Equipped with a Dolby NR system as a noise reduction system.Tape start memory function can be installed.Set the tape counter to position 000 and press the button. Press the rewind button to stop at position 000.Equipped with an independent recording volume and a recording master volume.There are 2 color variations of black and silver.There was a wood cabinet as an optional item sold separately.

sections.overview: Cassette deck without after-monitor function from 670 zx.Equipped with an automatic azimuth alignment function that automates the adjustment of the azimuth.This allows adjustment only by setting the tape to be recorded and turning the calibration switch ON. Adjustment is completed when the indicator of the play button stops blinking.In actual operation, when the calibration switch is turned ON, the built-in 400Hz0dB test signal is turned ON and recorded. Then, the 400 Hz sine wave signal reproduced immediately is converted into a square wave signal, and the advance (delay) between the left and right channels is detected by a phase discrimination circuit. This phase shift causes a switching circuit to control the output of the operational amplifier. The output of the operational amplifier = the plus or minus voltage applied to the motor terminal changes depending on whether the right channel is advanced or delayed relative to the left channel, and the direction of motor rotation changes. This causes the lever connected to the reduction gear to move and adjust the tilt angle of the recording head.On the 670 zx, calibration is performed by displaying the playback level on the peak meter.The mechanism uses a frequency distributed double capstan system.In this method, the double capstan method, in which the tape is held firmly by two pinch rollers and a capstan, reduces modulation noise and various disturbances. In addition, focusing on the flutter components caused by the correlation between the capstan and the tape, by changing the diameters of the two capstan, overlap of the flutter peaks is avoided and the characteristics are improved.In the single-capstan type, the contact between the tape and the head is secured by the crimping force of the head pad mounted in the cassette tape. In the double-capstan type, however, the head pad is not necessary because a constant tape tension is always applied between the two capstan. Therefore, a pad lifter is mounted to suppress the characteristic change by eliminating the head pad.The chassis uses a resonance damping type chassis. Aluminum alloy with large vibration damping characteristics is used, and resin molded parts are combined to absorb microvibration and suppress resonance.The mechanism is controlled by C-MOS logic control. The control cam linked to the motor drives mechanisms such as the head base and pinch roller, and simultaneously operates the muting circuit. Unlike the method using the plunger, it can operate quietly and smoothly with less mechanical noise.In addition, the six control buttons of this mechanism drive system allow for operations other than the normal tape control. When the Pause button is pressed from the FF / Dew state, it is used for queuing, when it is pressed again, it is used for RAMM (Automatic Tracking), and when the Rec button is pressed during recording, it is used for Rec mute as long as it is pressed. These operations can also be performed with an optional remote control unit.The head section uses a discrete three head system in which the recording head, reproducing head, and erasing head are completely independent.A P-8L type head is used for the playback head.This head is a 0.6 micron narrow gap reproducing head made of crystal and enables flat reproduction up to ultra-high frequencies. Moreover, by adopting a unique head shape and structure, it eliminates low-frequency waviness called contour effect, and realizes ultra-low frequency reproduction of 10 Hz.In addition, it has excellent wear resistance, and there is no degradation of characteristics even after 10,000 hours of use.The R-8L type recording head is used.This is a 3.5 micron gap head using a crystal, and the core does not saturate even when metal tape, which requires a large bias current, generates a sharp critical zone and enables recording with less distortion.E-8L type head is used for the erasing head.It is a direct flux double-gap type and overcomes the signal erasure effect due to poor low-frequency erasure capability during recording and spontaneous magnetization during playback from the material and structure aspects.In the recording amplifier section, the coupling capacitor connected to the recording head is eliminated to make it directly connected and DC. This reduces distortion during recording and prevents low-frequency phase distortion.It employs a double NF circuit that applies a negative feedback to the capacitors of the recording and playback equalizers. This reduces the distortion generated by the capacitors, while maintaining high DC stability.By improving the linearity and setting the clipping level higher, it is possible to record accurately from very small input to very large input.Equipped with a pointer type level indicator.This level meter displays the peak level in a wide range from the noise level of -40dB to the saturation level of + 7 dB.It is equipped with RAMM (Random Access Music Memory) as an automatic cue function.You can fast-forward or rewind up to a maximum of, up to a maximum of nine tracks, and start tracking or playback. If you count too many tracks due to misreading, press the Rec button to count down.It is equipped with a manual queuing function. If you then press the FF/Rew button continuously, the speed will be reduced to about 1/5.It is equipped with a one touch Rec-Mute function. sections.overview: This is a cassette deck with some functions such as half speed omitted or changed from 680 zx.Equipped with an automatic azimuth alignment function that automates the adjustment of the azimuth.This allows adjustment only by setting the tape to be recorded and turning the calibration switch ON. Adjustment is completed when the indicator of the play button stops blinking.In actual operation, when the calibration switch is turned ON, the built-in 400Hz0dB test signal is turned ON and recorded. Then, the 400 Hz sine wave signal reproduced immediately is converted into a square wave signal, and the advance (delay) between the left and right channels is detected by a phase discrimination circuit. This phase shift causes a switching circuit to control the output of the operational amplifier. The output of the operational amplifier = the plus or minus voltage applied to the motor terminal changes depending on whether the right channel is advanced or delayed relative to the left channel, and the direction of motor rotation changes. This causes the lever connected to the reduction gear to move and adjust the tilt angle of the recording head.The mechanism uses a frequency distributed double capstan system.In this method, the double capstan method, in which the tape is held firmly by two pinch rollers and a capstan, reduces modulation noise and various disturbances. In addition, focusing on the flutter components caused by the correlation between the capstan and the tape, by changing the diameters of the two capstan, overlap of the flutter peaks is avoided and the characteristics are improved.In the single-capstan type, the contact between the tape and the head is secured by the crimping force of the head pad mounted in the cassette tape. In the double-capstan type, however, the head pad is not necessary because a constant tape tension is always applied between the two capstan. Therefore, a pad lifter is mounted to suppress the characteristic change by eliminating the head pad.The chassis uses a resonance damping type chassis. Aluminum alloy with large vibration damping characteristics is used, and resin molded parts are combined to absorb microvibration and suppress resonance.The mechanism is controlled by C-MOS logic control. The control cam linked to the motor drives mechanisms such as the head base and pinch roller, and simultaneously operates the muting circuit. Unlike the method using the plunger, it can operate quietly and smoothly with less mechanical noise.In addition, the six control buttons of this mechanism drive system allow for operations other than the normal tape control. When the Pause button is pressed from the FF / Dew state, it is used for queuing, when it is pressed again, it is used for RAMM (Automatic Tracking), and when the Rec button is pressed during recording, it is used for Rec mute as long as it is pressed. These operations can also be performed with an optional remote control unit.The head section uses a discrete three head system in which the recording head, reproducing head, and erasing head are completely independent.A P-8L type head is used for the playback head.This head is a 0.6 micron narrow gap reproducing head made of crystal and enables flat reproduction up to ultra-high frequencies. Moreover, by adopting a unique head shape and structure, it eliminates low-frequency waviness called contour effect, and realizes ultra-low frequency reproduction of 10 Hz.In addition, it has excellent wear resistance, and there is no degradation of characteristics even after 10,000 hours of use.The R-8L type recording head is used.This is a 3.5 micron gap head using a crystal, and the core does not saturate even when metal tape, which requires a large bias current, generates a sharp critical zone and enables recording with less distortion.E-8L type head is used for the erasing head.It is a direct flux double-gap type and overcomes the signal erasure effect due to poor low-frequency erasure capability during recording and spontaneous magnetization during playback from the material and structure aspects.In the recording amplifier section, the coupling capacitor connected to the recording head is eliminated to make it directly connected and DC. This reduces distortion during recording and prevents low-frequency phase distortion.It employs a double NF circuit that applies a negative feedback to the capacitors of the recording and playback equalizers. This reduces the distortion generated by the capacitors, while maintaining high DC stability.By improving the linearity and setting the clipping level higher, it is possible to record accurately from very small input to very large input.Equipped with a pointer type level indicator.This level meter displays the peak level in a wide range from the noise level of -40dB to the saturation level of + 7 dB.It is equipped with RAMM (Random Access Music Memory) as an automatic cue function.You can fast-forward or rewind up to a maximum of, up to a maximum of nine tracks, and start tracking or playback. If you count too many tracks due to misreading, press the Rec button to count down.It is equipped with a manual queuing function. If you press the Pause / Queue button during FF/Rew, the speed will be reduced to about 1/3 and you can listen to the recorded sound. If you then press the FF/Rew button continuously, the speed will be reduced to about 1/5.It is equipped with a one touch Rec-Mute function. If you press the Record button during recording, the input signal will be cut during that time and the recording will be silent.Equipped with a Dolby level calibration function, the built-in 400Hz0dB test tone and 3-head configuration allow for one action.Equipped with timer recording and playback mechanism, it is possible to record absence and play alarm clock by combining with audio timer.It comes with a rack-mount adapter, 19-inch panel width, 2 1/4-inch mounting screw pitch, EIA-standard rack-size and removable.Equipped with a 3-position tape selector, it supports EX (normal type), SX (chrome type) and ZX (metal tape). The 120 ? s/70 ? s equalizer can be switched independently.Equipped with a Dolby NR system as a noise reduction system.The 670 zx is equipped with a dedicated Dolby circuit for both recording and playback, enabling after-monitoring.Equipped with a high-output headphone port.Equipped with a pitch control function, playback speed can be changed by approximately   6%.Equipped with high-speed shut-off function.Equipped with a tape start memory function.Equipped with MPX filter.Equipped with a dedicated power terminal for the Black Box Series (up to 125 ma), peripheral devices for tape decks, amplifiers, and Black Box Series can be used without a dedicated power supply.Compatible with optional Remote Control Unit RM-200.

sections.title: NAKAMICHI 681ZX
sections.overview: The second generation of the 680 ZX was announced at the same time as the 682 ZX. This is a standard speed single speed stereo cassette deck.Unlike the 682 zx, the Dolby NR processor and its peripheral circuit are used for both recording and playback, and simultaneous recording and playback monitoring is not possible.The mechanism uses a frequency-distributed double capstan system to achieve stable tape travel and uniform head touch. At the same time, the two capstan diameters and the fly-wheel diameters are changed to avoid overlapping of the flutter cycle. This reduces rotation unevenness and modulation noise. In addition, the tape pad lifter prevents adverse effects due to uneven pad pressure and slight vibration of the pad spring material.In addition, vibrations from motors and other rotating bodies are transmitted to the tape, which can increase flutter. To reduce this, we use aluminum alloy, which has a higher damping property than iron, as a chassis material. Resin is out-plated on aluminum alloy to absorb small vibrations and prevent resonance.When the control button is pressed, the logic circuit is activated and the control motor is used to operate the mechanism.By driving the cam with a motor instead of using a solenoid plunger, the sound at the time of operation is reduced, damage to tape and transport is reduced, temperature rise is lowered, and power consumption is reduced.The main motor uses a PLL servo motor to detect rotational speed fluctuations, compare the phase with the reference signal the reference signal oscillator, and control the rotational speed to an accurate value, thereby achieving high-precision rotation.The head uses a discrete three head system in which a recording head, a reproducing head and an erasing head are completely separated from each other.The P-8L type read head is used. By using a laminated core made of crystalline material, the narrow gap of 0.6 microns prevents loss during playback. The frequency response extends to 22 kHz. In addition, the shape is designed to eliminate the low-frequency waviness (contour effect), resulting in flat playback down to the ultra-low-frequency range. By using a special shape to eliminate the core deflection phenomenon, the read head is durable for more than 10,000 hours.The recording head uses an R-8L type. Like the read head, the gap is 3.5 microns with a laminated core made of crystalline material. As with the read head, this head also uses a special shape to ensure more than 10,000 hours of durability.E-8L type is used for the erasing head. It is a double gap type using ferrite core with excellent high frequency characteristics and Sendust core with high magnetic flux density at the tip.The recording EQ circuit, playback EQ circuit and output-line amplifier circuit use a double NF circuit that applies negative feedback to the electrolytic capacitor. This reduces distortion caused by the capacitor and stabilizes direct current.In addition, the recording equalizer and the recording head, and the reproducing head and the reproducing equalizer amplifier are directly connected to each other and the coupling capacitor is removed to improve the characteristics. For example, distortion during recording and reproduction is reduced, and phase shift in low frequencies is prevented.Equipped with an auto-calibration function, you can adjust the azimuth and recording / playback level simultaneously and automatically with one calibration operation.The azimuth adjustment is started by pressing the Auto Cal and Play buttons from the recording pose. First, a 400 Hz test tone is recorded and played back, and the phase difference between the left and right channels is detected. The signal is sent to the operational amplifier to control the motor, which moves the lever connected via the belt and gear to adjust the tilt angle of the recording head. When the azimuth deviation is eliminated, the phase difference disappears, the motor stops and the adjustment is completed.When the azimuth adjustment is started, the level adjustment is also started at the same time. The signal reproduced with the 400 Hz test tone is detected through the buffer amplifier and applied to the comparator. The comparator compares the signal with the reference signal. The voltage difference causes the motor to rotate, the connected slide volume for calibration is operated, and the signal current (recording level) of the recording head is changed. This causes the playback output level to change, and when it becomes equal to the reference level, the motor stops and the adjustment is completed.The adjustment time, including the azimuth adjustment, is approximately 6 seconds and the error is within   0.5 dB. The adjustment range is   2.5 dB from the reference value, which is sufficient to cover normal music tapes.Equipped with a bias adjustment function that can adjust the bias current to a value suitable for the tape being used.This adjustment is performed by recording and playing back a 15 Hz (-20dB) test tone while observing the reading on the level meter, which is enlarged by 20 dB for easy adjustment.The adjustment volume is provided for each tape selector and each left / right channel. The adjustment range is   4.5 dB for the EX position (normal type),   3 dB for the SX position (CrO2 type), and   6 dB for the ZX position (metal tape).In addition to Dolby B Type NR for noise reduction, Dolby C Type NR with higher noise reduction effect is equipped.Dolby C Type NR basically has the same operation principle as B type NR. By receiving 10 db each from two noise reduction processors of high level stage and low level stage, the noise reduction of 20 db in total is realized.In addition, the C-type employs a sliding band method in which the frequency at which the operation starts is variable according to the input level and the frequency component, thus suppressing a bleeding phenomenon called noise breathing.With the Dolby NR switch, switching between C type / B type / off is possible.It is equipped with a wide range peak level meter of FL display which displays -40dB to + 10 db in 24 segments.It is equipped with a RAMM function that allows you to select and cue your favorite song from the songs recorded on the tape.It is equipped with an easy queuing function. If you press the pause button during FF/Rew, the speed is reduced to about 1/3 and you can listen to the recorded content. If you press the FF/Rew button continuously, the speed is reduced to about 1/5 and you can easily start the track.The Rec Mute function is built-in. If you press the Rec button during recording, the input signal is cut as long as you keep it pressed, creating a silent recording section.Built-in MPX filter.By using the audio timer, timer recording and playback are possible.Remote control unit sold separately can be used to operate from a remote location.

sections.title: NAKAMICHI 700
sections.overview: This is a sister model of the Tri Tracer Nakamichi 1000. It is an authentic 3-head cassette deck that challenges the limits and possibilities of cassette.It uses a full 3-head system, a ferrite core recording head, an erasing head, and a hard super permalloy core reproducing head with a narrow gap of 0.7 ? m. In addition to the constant tension effect produced by the double-gap capstan system, it also has good adhesion to the tape, and plays flat f-characteristics up to high frequencies.In order to cope with the vertical displacement of the tape and the head caused by the distortion during the molding of the cassette case, the recording head vertical adjustment function by the alignment beacon is equipped.It is equipped with an adjustment mechanism that records and reproduces the built-in 400 Hz signal and detects its output with the advance and delay of the phase. Adjustment can be made simply by turning the knob while observing the blinking of the two emitting diodes.Equipped with control by IC logic circuit, all tape controls can be operated with one touch.In addition, the timing of the read / write amplifier, bias oscillation and mechanism operation is completely controlled to suppress the occurrence of click noise.Other than that, it is equipped with mechanisms such as muting of signal sound and memory counter.The level meter is equipped with a dB peak level meter so that there is no need to worry about over-recording caused by the pointer not being able to follow sharp peak input like general VU meters.We have overcome the mechanical accuracy limit of cassette tapes from the closed loop and double capstan drive side.Characteristics such as wow flutter have been improved by the use of a DC-servo motor and the effect of two flywheels which are large to the limit and increase effective mass.It is equipped with a switching device for low-noise tape and chrome tape. sections.title: NAKAMICHI 700II
sections.overview: While the 1000 Series pursued performance, the 700 Series aimed for something with beauty. The performance was as good as the 1000 Series Series, and the 700 II was one of the few 3-head cassette decks at that time.By using an SR head instead of a permalloy head for the reproducing head, we succeeded in extending the life of the head.A newly developed crystal ferrite head is used for the recording head.The crystal ferrite head has low high-frequency frequency loss, it operates effectively at a bias frequency as high as 105 kHz. In addition, processing strain has been removed by improving the manufacturing method, and the magnetic field is focused strongly in an extremely narrow range and good high-frequency characteristics are obtained.We succeeded in reducing temperature rise and improving erasing efficiency by installing a crystal ferrite erasing head instead of the conventional AC erasing method.In addition, stainless steel tape guides are attached to the top and bottom of this erasing head to improve the running accuracy of the tape.The 700 II uses an air damper that uses a cylinder to ensure that the contact between the tape and the head occurs quietly and slowly.Similarly, a cylinder-type air damper is used for tape ejection, and the ejection speed can be varied by needle throttle.400 Hz, 0 dB test tone enables accurate Dolby level adjustment.5-channel 3-way mixing is possible with a blend microphone input.

sections.title: NAKAMICHI 700ZXE
sections.overview: This is a cassette deck that has almost completely inherited the basic performance of the 700 ZXL while simplifying its functions.Equipped with an auto-calibration function that automatically adjusts the recording head azimuth, bias current, and recording / playback level according to the tape to be used.In the auto-calibration operation, first set the normal (EX), chrome (SX), and metal tape (ZX) tape selectors and the playback equalizer for 120 ? s (normal) and 70 ? s (chrome and metal) according to the type of tape to be used. From the recording standby state, press the Play button while holding down the auto-calibration button to perform the adjustment in the same flow as the flowchart.The adjustment starts with recording and playback of a 400 Hz, 15kHz-20dB signal, and the bias adjustment adjusts the bias current so that the 15 kHz output is equal to the 400 Hz signal. The recording and playback level changes slightly by changing the bias current, so this process is repeated once again to complete the adjustment. When the adjustment is complete, the tape is rewound to the starting position of 0000 and stops.During adjustment, the display panel will blink. When the adjustment is completed, it will go off. The EX, SX and ZX tape position lamps selected by the tape selector will light. When the adjustment range is exceeded, the tape stops running and the tape position lamp will blink.The bias current and recording / playback level data adjusted by auto-calibration are stored in memory until the next adjustment operation is performed to prevent data from being lost when the power is turned off during timer recording.Equipped with RAMM (Random Access Music Memory).Unlike the 700 zxl RAMM, the 700 ZXE RAMM has a function of passing up to 9 songs and calling up and selecting the desired song. This is a method of detecting a blank between songs of 3 to 4 seconds.The head part uses Nakamichi's unique discrete three head configuration, and the recording head, reproducing head, and erasing head are completely separated from each other in structure, enabling accurate azimuth adjustment.A read head and a recording head are placed in the center window of the cassette, and an erase head is placed in the left side small window. Both are placed between the double capstan, and the stable tape tension ensures head touch with no spacing loss.A P-8L-type playhead is used as the playhead.This head uses a laminated crystalline core and is compact. In addition, the narrow gap of 0.6 microns eliminates many losses during playback, enabling ultra-high-frequency playback. In addition, the shape eliminates low-frequency waviness (contour effect), enabling ultra-low-frequency flat playback.In addition, it adopts a special shape that eliminates the phenomenon of unbalanced core, ensuring a long life of more than 10,000 hours (Nakamichi experimental value).The recording head uses an R-8L catalogue sound head.As with the reproducing head, it uses a laminated core made of crystalline material with a gap of 3.5 microns. This gives high coercivity and sharp critical zones when using high-density tapes. In addition, even when a large bias current is applied, there is no magnetostriction or saturation, making it possible to record high MOL (maximum output level) from low to high range.This head also uses a special shape to ensure a lifetime of more than one man-hour, just like the read head.E-8L-type erase head is used for the erase head.This head is a double-gap type with Sendust with high magnetic flux density in the front and ferrite core with excellent high-frequency characteristics in the other parts.The mechanism section incorporates Nakamichi's know-how, such as a frequency-distributed double capstan and a resonance braking chassis.The capstan uses a frequency-distributed double capstan system to achieve stable tape travel and uniform head touch. The two capstan diameters are 3 mm on the supply side and 2.5 mm on the take-up side. By changing the diameters of the flywheels, the overlap of flutter cycles is avoided, rotational unevenness is reduced, and modulation noise is improved.In addition, it is equipped with a tape pad lifter to prevent adverse effects due to uneven pad pressure and slight vibration of pad spring material.The chassis uses a resonance damping type chassis.This chassis is made of aluminum alloy, which has a larger damping property than iron, and resin is out-plated to absorb microvibration and prevent resonance.A tape control by C-MOS logic is adopted for the mechanical control, and the cam is driven by a motor.Compared with the plunger-driven type, this type has a very small sound at the time of operation. Moreover, damage to the tape and the tape transport is reduced because it can contact the tape softly. It also has features such as low temperature rise inside and low power consumption.A PLL servo motor is used as the main motor.This motor detects rotational speed fluctuations and controls the rotational speed to an accurate value by comparing the phase with the reference signal, enabling high-precision rotation.A double-NF circuit is used for the equalizer circuit of the reproduction amplifier to stabilize DC and reduce distortion.(There is no direct connection between the playhead and the first stage amplifier as was done in the 700 zxl.)In the recording equalizer amplifier, the final stage amplifier is directly connected to the recording head, and a double NF circuit is used to reduce distortion during recording. The recording input can be mixed with a 3-point microphone input of L/R / Blend (center) and a line input. A subsonic or MPX filter can be used.It has a built-in Dolby B type noise reduction system.Equipped with an extra terminal, a separately sold noise reduction system can be connected.To use external noise reduction, switch the NR switch on the ceiling panel.Equipped with LED peak level meter.The level range of the Conometer is 50 dB (-40db to + 10 dB), and the peak level and peak hold can be displayed simultaneously using a bar graph with 30 segments on one channel. The peak hold is displayed for approximately 6-7 seconds and then reset.Equipped with a 4-digit digital tape counter.This counter can count from 0000 to 9999 in the positive direction and to -999 in the negative direction. Memory playback / stop can be performed in conjunction with the memory switch.The count is directly connected to the reel axis to perform precise pulse detection, minimizing errors.Equipped with a display to confirm information such as auto-tuning, noise reduction status, RAMM, etc.It is equipped with queuing mechanism which can change speed in 2 stages.Equipped with a RecMute mechanism that can make a silent recording part.Built-in 400 hz test tone.Timer recording / playback is available.Equipped with a high-output headphone port.Remote control unit RM-200 was sold separately.With RM 200, you can perform tape operations, including automatic RAMM music selection, as well as Rec mute and queuing operations.

sections.overview: This is a stereo cassette deck designed to achieve high sound quality by pursuing new value that has never been seen before amid price constraints.In pursuit of sound quality, only the minimum necessary functions are installed, and elements that adversely affect sound quality are eliminated.The recording equalizer amplifier employs a double-NF circuit to reduce distortion and stabilize DC. It also provides accurate head loss compensation based on theoretical values. It also uses a high-performance low-noise operational amplifier to gain dynamic range.The playback equalizer amplifier is also a double-NF type, and a discrete configuration is adopted by selecting a transistor that is compatible with the playback head.In order to prevent distortion of the waveform of the bias current and degradation of sound quality caused by modulation of the music signal due to unstable voltage, a constant voltage power supply is turned on to the bias oscillation circuit and a luxurious circuit is used for the oscillator to suppress waveform distortion.In addition, a dedicated bias adjustment mechanism is provided inside the set for each tape position of the left and right channels ZX, SX and EX to adjust to the best bias.The head uses a 1.2 ? gap high-bias read / write head with a hyperbolic contact surface to the tape.In the mechanism section, we pay attention to the fact that the accuracy of the take-up motor affects the flutter. We use motors with proper bearings and make pulleys with high roundness made of metal to prevent flutter even at the stage of power transmission.In addition, a special microprocessor is used for mechanism control, and the current situation is judged from the condition of the cam attached to the mechanism, and the processor issues commands to operate the motor.Every last BX-1 produced has been adjusted for about 30 items, and the dispersion of each product is suppressed.Equipped with a 2-position equalizer switch, two positions of 120 ? s and 70 ? s can be selected.Equipped with an LED peak level meter, it can be checked in the range of -30dB to + 5 db.Equipped with a recording balance and recording master volume.

sections.title: NAKAMICHI BX-2
sections.overview: A two head cassette deck adopting Dolby B type and C type.The head part adopts a 2-head configuration using an RP-2D read / write head and an E-2D erase head.The RP-2D head reduces the waviness in the low range by processing the contact surface with the tape into a hyperbolic shape.Single capstan system is adopted for the mechanism part.In this system, the wow is less likely to come out than in the double capstan system, but there is also a problem that the flutter is increased. In order to solve this problem, the BX-2 takes note of the effect of the rotational accuracy of the winding motor on the flutter, and adopts a metallic pulley with extremely high roundness to prevent the flutter from coming out even in the power transmission stage.A double NF circuit is used for the recording equalizer circuit and the playback equalizer circuit in the amplifier section to reduce distortion and stabilize DC, and to compensate for head loss based on theoretical values.In addition, a discrete configuration using a low-noise transistor compatible with the reproducing head is used for the reproduction equalizer circuit, and a low-noise operational amplifier is used for the recording equalizer circuit to obtain a dynamic range.By making the bias current oscillator extremely stable and with very little waveform distortion, the music signal is prevented from being modulated by the instability of the bias current. In addition, there is a built-in bias adjustment mechanism for each tape position of the L and R channels, ZX, SX, and EX, so that the best bias is obtained.The tape control mechanism uses a silent mechanism that uses a microprocessor and a dedicated motor. It is driven by a dedicated motor without using a solenoid plunger to reduce operating noise.The BX-2 has a cam with a special shape attached to the mechanism, which detects the operating condition, outputs 3-bit digital information, and is controlled by a microcomputer.As for the contact between the head and the tape, we reduce the damage to the tape by moving the head quickly until it comes into contact with the tape and slowly from immediately before it comes into contact.Equipped with Dolby B Type and Dolby C Type as noise reduction system.The front panel uses aluminum thick material that has been pulled out.The cassette lid and meter are made of 5 mm thick acrylic glass.Equipped with a 2-position equalizer switch, 120 ? s and 70 ? s can be selected.Equipped with an LED peak level meter that can display from -30dB to + 5 dB.It is equipped with a 4-digit counter using LED, and with 0000 as the base point, plus counts to 9999 and minus counts to -999.Equipped with a recording balance volume and a recording master volume.An MPX filter switch is mounted to prevent malfunction of the Dolby NR circuit by removing 19 kHz pilot signal included in FM radio wave.Equipped with memory play and memory stop functions.When the memory switch is set to the Memory Play position, the tape counter 0000 stops the playback from the fast-forward / rewind operation, and the playback starts automatically. When the memory switch is set to the Memory Stop position, the playback stops automatically at 0000 from the fast-forward / rewind operation.It is equipped with the one touch rec pause function, and when you press the rec button, it automatically enters the recording pause state.Then press the play button to start recording.Equipped with Rec Mute function.Equipped with timer recording and playback functions. By combining with an optional timer, you can record your absence or play an alarm clock.It has an output volume.It has a headphone port.All the products had about 30 adjustments including bias L/R and recording / playback level L/R.There are 2 color variations of silver and black.

sections.title: NAKAMICHI BX-125
sections.overview: In addition to the simple configuration of 2-head single capstan, this is a basic cassette deck with minimal functions.It is made in pursuit of the total balance for the sound as much as it is made simple.In order to maintain an optimum balance between recording and playback characteristics, the effective gap width of the head is set at 1.2 microns, which is the playback limit of 20 kHz, and Sendust with a high saturation magnetic flux density of 10,000 gauss is used as the core material.At Nakamichi, the core material is processed without stress at all, and a special treatment is applied after each process to prevent distortion. By carrying out strict and meticulous manufacturing control, the linearity of the gap is kept severe, and the regenerative capacity of 20 kHz is obtained.It also uses a unique hyperbolic shape that minimizes the contour effect and reduces low-range waviness.The erasing head uses a double-gap type that uses ferrite as a core material with excellent high-frequency characteristics.High frequency loss is small, and even metal tapes with large coercive force and residual magnetic flux density have a high erasing rate.The L/R printed circuit board pattern and circuit configuration of the amplifier section are designed to be perfectly symmetrical. Consideration is given to balancing part characteristics and aligning the signal shield line length in L/R.In addition, over 30 items of adjustment are carried out in the manufacturing process for every unit to improve the total quality.In the recording amplifier section, the compensation amount can be reduced because the characteristics of the head are good. As a result, the flat frequency characteristics are maintained with a sufficient margin.In addition, a double NF circuit has been adopted to reduce the distortion factor and to improve the DC stability while suppressing the generation of the distortion by the capacitor by having NF loops with separate DC and AC components.In addition, a high-speed low-noise operational amplifier is used in the amplifier stage to reduce distortion.The playback amplifier section is equipped with a double NF circuit similar to the recording amplifier section to improve constant distortion and DC stability.In the mechanism part, removal of "flutter" is the most important point in designing the transport mechanism.In the single-capstan type of the BX-125, the rotational accuracy of the reel motor for winding is closely related to the flutter. Therefore, a high-performance motor is used and the pulleys are made of metal with high roundness to prevent flutter during power transmission.In addition, by firmly fixing the cassette in the reference position, vibration caused by looseness is eliminated.Nakamichi's own silent mechanism is adopted.In this system, no plunger is used to drive the mechanism, and a dedicated motor controlled by a microprocessor drives the operation control cam of the head base and brake. All operations can be started quickly by simply lightly touching the operation button.In particular, damage to the tape is suppressed by making it a 2-speed transmission type in which the head moves quickly until just before it touches the tape at the start of the Play operation and slows down when it touches the tape.Equipped with a double-speed master fader control that allows you to fade in and fade out in two stages of 4 seconds or 2 seconds.It is equipped with many functions such as auto-repeat function, Dolby B / C type NR system, wide-scale LED peak level meter, MPX filter, memory stop, timer rec / play function, L/R independent recording level control, output volume, 3-position tape selector, equalizer selector, headphone jack, one touch rec pause, etc.

sections.title: NAKAMICHI CASSETTEDECK1
sections.overview: This cassette deck has been developed as a reference machine for the new era that inherits the tradition of Nakamichi.It uses a 3-head system in which each of erasure, recording and playback is received by a dedicated head. The shape, material and gap width of the head can be optimized respectively, and characteristics can be pushed to the limit.The core of the recording and reproducing heads is made of Crosalloy, which has excellent sound quality and magnetic characteristics close to the ideal. In addition, by adopting a special structure, the head is prevented from losing one side and has a long life.Top grade oxygen-free copper (OFC) wire is used for the head coil.It is equipped with a new mechanism for manually adjusting the azimuth of the playhead so that you can determine the point at which the best high-frequency response can be obtained during playback.The mechanism employs a frequency distributed closed loop double capstan.In this system, two capstan and flywheel with different diameters are adopted in order to avoid the increase of modulation noise due to the overlap of resonance frequencies. In addition, vibration absorbing material is used for the head base assembly to suppress vibration and eliminate the adverse effect on sound quality.This structure eliminates the need for a tape pad attached to the cassette to stabilize the head touch. The unique mechanism of the tape pad lifter prevents modulation noise caused by the tape pad.High-quality elements are used for the recording and playback amplifiers, and dual-monoconstruction is used to eliminate interference between channels. In addition, coupling capacitors, which cause distortion, are eliminated in the DC amplifier configuration.The recording amplifier circuit is pure A-class and has high stability. For each tape position, an LR-independent adjustment circuit for recording level and bias level at a total of 12 points draws out the capacity of the tape.The read amplifier circuit consists of only discrete elements and is integrated with the transport side read head assembly to reduce signal transmission loss caused by cable routing.The power supply circuit uses a multi-regulated power supply system that supplies power independently for each stage and section to prevent interference such as noise contamination.It includes a microprocessor-controlled motor drive silent mechanism, tape sag prevention, bias fine adjustment volume, program check, and MPX filter with defeat.Equipped with Dolby B/C NR as noise reduction.Equipped with timer recording / playback mechanism.

sections.overview: The cassette deck was developed not as a low-cost 3-head model but as a top-of-the-line 2-head model.The head uses RP-2G, which is a SENDUST recording / reproducing head.This head is manufactured using Nakamichi's unique precision processing technology cultivated in the development of the CrystalHead. It is reduced to the processed ?? by a processing method that does not give any stress to the core material and a special treatment that prevents distortion in each process. This realizes a read / write head that is as close as possible to the theoretical characteristics. As a result, an ordinary head with a gap width of 1.2 microns has acquired excellent characteristics of 20 Hz to 20 kHz.The mechanism part uses Nakamichi's unique silent mechanism.This system uses a dedicated motor controlled by a microprocessor to smoothly move the head base up and down to prevent damage to the tape and head.In addition, a newly developed load-sensitive reel driver is used for the reel motor. By detecting the load applied to the left and right reel shafts, the driving force is always maintained at the optimum level. This prevents damage to the tape and reduces the flutter content of the sound.A reference DC amplifier is used for the amplifier section.By adopting a 2-head system, we have been able to pursue quality within a limited cost, and have achieved excellent characteristics with a dynamic range of + 20 dB or more and a single unit distortion rate of 0.005% or less.In addition, a dual mono configuration is adopted for the board layout.High-precision one way transport has been adopted.Multi-regulated power supply is adopted for the power supply part to eliminate mutual interference.Acoustic insulator is used to reduce the influence of external vibration.Equipped with Dolby B/C Type NR as a noise reduction system.Equipped with an independent equalizer switch.Equipped with an output volume.System remote terminal and headphone terminal are installed.There are approximately 30 adjustment mechanisms inside, and by carefully adjusting all items in the manufacturing process, each individual error is pushed to the limit and excellent characteristics are acquired.For example, a typical cassette deck has only one semi-fixed volume for bias adjustment for each L and R, so only one of the three tape positions can be adjusted accurately. On the other hand, the CR series has a total of six semi-fixed volumes for L and R. By pursuing the characteristics of all positions to the limit, excellent sound quality is obtained even in normal position.In addition, 56 items of actual measurement of characteristics were carried out on a perfectly adjusted deck, and every item was strictly measured one by one, and only the individual which sufficiently satisfied the specification is shipped.

sections.title: NAKAMICHI CR-40
sections.overview: This cassette deck was developed with feedback from the latest amplifier technology cultivated in the development of high-grade control amplifiers.A fully independent discrete three head system is used for the head part.In this method, each head can be completely independent, preventing the deterioration of the high-frequency characteristics due to the magnetic azimuth shift that occurs during actual recording with the Combination 3 head.In addition, Nakamichi's original head alignment system has been adopted. The head height, azimuth, and tilt (front and back tilt) of each head are precisely adjusted one by one while actually running the test tape by the adjustment screw incorporated in the solid main base. This drives the characteristics to the utmost limit and always enables stable ultra-high-range playback.The head uses a crystal head.The core of this head is laminated with a thin crystalline material to minimize high-frequency frequency loss of the head by carrying out all the work through a chemical process that does not stress the material at all. This allows for a difference in sound resolution and elongation compared with a single deck in which the head loss is compensated by the amplifier even at the same 20 kHz recording and playback.The recording head uses Nakamichi's unique focused gap method, which generates an extremely sharp magnetic field, enabling deep recording on the tape. Tapes recorded with this method can maintain a wide dynamic range over the entire band and are resistant to demagnetization, making them suitable for long-term storage.In addition, we have sought to improve S/N by reducing the size of the head. In general, small heads tend to produce low-frequency waviness due to the contour effect, but we have solved this problem by reducing low-frequency waviness even if it is small.A reference DC amplifier of all stages DC configuration newly developed for the CR series is adopted in the amplifier section.The playback amplifier is a fully discrete configuration, and the dynamic characteristics are improved by achieving low noise and stability with a simple circuit, avoiding the differential system which makes the circuit complicated. The recording amplifier is a pure A-class operation, which brings out the performance of the recording head.In addition, line amplifiers and headphone amplifiers have also been converted into DC amplifiers, resulting in overall high performance.In order to reduce interference with the audio part such as the logic part and bias circuit, and wamble of the power supply voltage of each part, the multi-regulated power supply, which is also used in the Nakamichi CD player, is installed in the power supply part. It consists of an independent 2-winding transformer, three master power regulators, and ten local power regulators to prevent mutual interference.The sound recording calibration mechanism uses a 15 kHz test tone, making it possible to make more severe adjustments than decks that adjust at lower frequencies such as 8 kHz.The drive motor is a brushless, slotless, coreless type DD capstan motor.This motor uses a heavy-duty motor that produces smooth rotation and pursues sound quality through a hearing test to minimize flutter components in the sense of hearing.The mechanism uses a frequency distributed closed loop double capstan system.It uses a silent mechanism with a dedicated motor and microprocessor to achieve quiet and stable operation.Copper-tight (copper-plated) chassis is used to reduce magnetic distortion and resonance.Dual mono configuration using oxygen-free copper pattern is adopted for the amplifier substrate.Uses a oxygen-free copper AC power cord.It is equipped with an acoustic insulator.Equipped with Dolby B-CNR as a noise reduction system.Equipped with an independent equalizer switch.Equipped with a tape slack prevention mechanism.Equipped with an output volume.System remote terminal is mounted.The headphone terminal is gold-plated.Gold plated input / output terminals are also used for input / output terminals.Gold plated oxygen-free copper pin cord is attached.There are approximately 30 adjustment mechanisms inside, and by carefully adjusting all items in the manufacturing process, each individual error is pushed to the limit and excellent characteristics are acquired.For example, a typical cassette deck has only one semi-fixed volume for bias adjustment for each L and R, so only one of the three tape positions can be adjusted accurately. sections.title: NAKAMICHI DR-1
sections.overview: This cassette deck was developed using Nakamichi's deck technology.Head part uses Nakamichi's unique discrete 3 head system.The discrete three head system, in which the three recording, playback, and erasing heads are structurally completely independent, enables extremely precise (magnetic and mechanical) azimuth adjustment, and also shuts out magnetic field interference by keeping the recording head and reproducing head far apart.The recording and reproducing heads use an inline recording head with a crystal-core for sound quality. In particular, the reproducing head has an ultra-narrow gap of 0.8 ?, enabling ultra-high-frequency playback at 21 kHz. The head coil uses top-grade oxygen-free copper (OFC) for low signal transmission loss.Equipped with a manually adjustable playhead azimuth tuning mechanism, it provides the best condition for playing back tapes recorded on other decks.The mechanism uses a closed-loop dual capstan system to obtain optimum tape tension and stable tape travel.The Nakamichi has added a unique twist to this method. The supply and take-up capstan diameters are slightly changed to create a frequency-distributed system that avoids overlapping flutter cycles and suppresses harmful tape vibrations. In addition, the Nakamichi is equipped with a unique tape pad lifter that controls tape travel with only two capstans, making it a more ideal method.
