sections.title: NAKAMICHI ZX-7
sections.overview: Equipped with various calibration functions, this stereo cassette deck aims at the limit of tape performance.It is equipped with a manual calibration mechanism. Using the adjustment mechanism arranged on the panel surface, the recording head azimuth, recording and playback level, and bias are performed in this order, so that the best condition can be obtained according to the tape used.First, set the tape selector to ZX (metal), SX (CrO2) or EX (normal) and press the Azimuth switch from the recording pause state to start the tape and record and play the 400 Hz test tone.The azimuth adjustment is completed by turning the adjustment knob so that the red indicator amplifier in the center lights up. Next, when the azimuth switch is turned off, it is automatically set to the level adjustment mode. While watching the indication on the level meter, turn the adjustment volume so that it is 0 dB for both the L and R channels.Finally, when the bias adjustment switch is turned on, a test tone of 15 kHz (-20dB) is recorded and played back. The sensitivity of the level meter is increased by 20 dB. Similarly to the level adjustment, the L/R bias adjustment volume is turned so that the level meter reaches 0 dB.When all adjustments are complete, press the Reset button to automatically rewind the tape back to the start position and the adjustment is complete.The mechanism control by N-MOS4-bit microprocessor is adopted, and the silent operation common to the Nakamichi deck is left as it is, and the deck itself considers the relation between the commanded operation information and the current operation state, and constructs a logic circuit to drive the mechanism more accurately.As a result, the operability and stability of the soft touch operation have been further improved. In addition, multifunctional functions such as auto playback, easy queuing and follow-up recording have been realized.Once you set the recording level and left / right channel balance, you can use the master fader control switch to automatically fade in and fade out the recording level.The switch has 2 stages, and you can choose 2 speeds of 6 seconds when you press it once and release it, and 2 seconds when you keep it pressed.In addition to the Dolby B NR, a Dolby C NR is also installed. By using a dedicated Dolby NR processor for both recording and playback, simultaneous monitoring of recording and playback is possible.In the C-type, two noise reduction processors (high level stage and low level stage) receive 10 dB each, and a total noise reduction of up to 20 dB is achieved. In addition, a sliding band method is adopted in which the frequency at which the operation starts is variable according to the input level and frequency component, preventing bleeding phenomenon.An anti-data network circuit reduces recording saturation caused by large instantaneous saturation.The mechanism employs a frequency-distributed double capstan system. The tape is sandwiched between two sets of capstan and pinch rollers to achieve stable tape travel and uniform head touch. In addition, the diameters of the two capstan and of the two capstan and the flywheel are changed to reduce rotation unevenness and improve modulation noise. In addition, by installing a tape pad lifter, adverse effects due to uneven pad pressure and slight vibration of the pad spring material are prevented. flutterIn order to prevent the flutter from increasing due to the vibration generated by motors and other rotating bodies being transmitted to the tape, we use aluminum alloy, which has a larger damping property than steel, as the chassis material. Plastic is out-plated on this alloy to absorb harmful microvibrations and prevent resonance.The microprocessor control and motor-driven mechanism realizes low sound at the time of operation and suitable tape drive. When the operation button is pressed, the microprocessor commands the control motor to operate the mechanism.By driving the cam with a motor instead of using a solenoid plunger, we have obtained advantages such as low sound at the time of operation, less damage to tape and transport due to soft contact with tape, less temperature rise, and less power consumption.The main motor uses a PLL servo motor that detects rotational speed fluctuations, compares the signal of the reference signal oscillator with the phase, and controls the rotational speed to an accurate value.The head section is dedicated to each of the three recording, playback and erasing heads, and uses a unique discrete three head system that is completely separated from the structure.The P-8L type is used for the playback head, which uses a laminated core made of quartz and a narrow gap of 0.6 microns to prevent losses. The R-8L type is used for the recording head, which uses a laminated core made of quartz and a gap of 3.5 microns. The E-8L type is used for the erasing head, which uses a ferrite core and a Sendust core at the tip.The recording EQ circuit, playback EQ circuit and monitor amplifier use a double NF circuit that applies negative feedback to an electrolytic capacitor. This reduces distortion caused by the capacitor and stabilizes direct current.The recording amplifier is directly connected to the recording head to prevent deterioration of sound quality caused by the coupling capacitor. In addition, a buffer amplifier is used for the input side of the recording amplifier, and the headphone amplifier is integrated into an IC to improve sound quality.Equipped with a 50 dB full-scale wide-range LED peak level meter that digitally displays -40dB to + 10 dB with 16 segments each on the left and right.This meter also functions as an adjustment meter for level / bias calibration, and the indicated value is increased by 20 dB increased by 20 dB so that adjustment is easy.Equipped with a tape counter with digital display by LED.It has a REC mute function so that you can record without a signal only while the REC MUTE switch is pressed.Equipped with MPX filter.You can use a general audio timer to record your absence or play an alarm clock.Tape operations such as recording and playback can be remotely controlled by the separately sold remote control unit.

sections.title: NAKAMICHI ZX-9
sections.overview: This is a cassette deck based on ZX-7 with improvements mainly on the mechanism and amplifier.The mechanism uses a direct drive system using Nakamichi's unique super linear torque DD motor.This motor has been developed focusing on flutter components that do not appear in figures on specifications, and is designed to eliminate uneven torque of the motor, which causes flutter.A general motor rotates by the repulsive force of S and N of the magnetic field, and when the coil moves from the S pole to the N pole, the pole is switched and the torque becomes 0 instantaneously. In order to eliminate this 0 torque state, a general motor increases the number of driving coils to use two or three phases. However, when each phase turns on or off alternately, torque unevenness occurs.To solve this problem, Nakamichi has come up with a method that creates three torques that vary sinusoidally with time and ensures that the resultant torque is always 1 in order to maintain constant torque at any moment. This method is used in the Super Linear Torque DD Motor.In the Super Linear Torque DD motor, the current supplied to the coil is a 2-phase sinusoidal wave and the magnet is also a ring-shaped one with star-shaped magnetization to form a sinusoidal wave with the strength of the S pole and the N pole, thereby eliminating torque unevenness.By adopting this motor, we have achieved excellent characteristics in the double-capstan system in which lowering the wow flutter is difficult.As a noise reduction system, Dolby B type and C type are mounted.Equipped with 3 types of tape selectors.In addition, in order to maximize the performance of each tape, it is equipped with a bias adjustment mechanism independent of the left and right, a recording and playback level adjustment mechanism independent of the left and right, and an azimuth adjustment mechanism.The mechanism uses a closed-loop dual capstan system to reduce modulation noise, and in the ZX-9, by changing the diameters of the two capstan, the inherent resonance frequencies of the capstan can be changed to avoid overlapping of flutter periods.In addition, two types of materials, aluminum and plastic, are used for the entire structure to absorb vibrations before they are transmitted to the head and tape.N-MOS4-bit microprocessor is used for the mechanism drive part.In the ZX-9, the tape control mechanism is driven by a motor and a cam, and the operating position is transmitted to the microcomputer by attaching a potentiometer to the control cam of the mechanism. This method enables quieter and smoother operation than the method of driving the mechanism with a plunger.In addition, because it can move quickly, it is possible to find the head accurately like a open-reel.The head has a 3-head configuration with completely independent recording, playback, and erasing heads.The recording equalizer circuit and the playback equalizer circuit are connected directly to the head without using a condenser, thereby eliminating sound quality degradation.In addition, the recording equalizer circuit and monitor amplifier are double-NF circuits that apply NFB to an electrolytic capacitor, and the playback equalizer circuit is DC-operated to reduce distortion.Equipped with an auto-playback function, you can stop at the position of the tape counter 0000 after fast forward or rewind and start playback automatically.With the Easy Queuing function, you can listen to your recording at a reduced speed in fast-forward or rewind mode. You can select a queuing speed of 1/3 or 1/6. You can also stop in queuing mode and start playback from a pause state.It is equipped with -up recording function, you can switch to recording mode while driving during playback.The master fader control function allows you to fade in and fade out.The switch has 2 stages, and you can choose 2 speeds of 6 seconds when you press it once and release it, and 2 seconds when you keep it pressed.Equipped with a Rec Mute function, you can record without a signal as long as you press the switch.Equipped with a 50 db full-scale wide-range LED peak level meter that digitally displays -40dB to + 10 db with 16 segments for L/R respectively.This meter can also be used as an adjustment meter for level / bias calibration. Especially for bias calibration, the indicated value is increased by 20 dB to make it easier to adjust.Equipped with a tape counter with a digital LED display that allows for positive counting up to 9999 and negative counting up to -999.Equipped with a timer recording and playback mechanism. By using a separately sold timer together, you can record your absence or play an alarm clock.It can be operated from a remote location by using the optional remote control unit.

sections.title: NAKAMICHI AV-10
sections.overview: An AV receiver developed by inheriting the design concept of the flagship model CA-1/PA-1.Contains a decoder for DTS and Dolby Digital / Dolby Pro Logic.The device uses a DSP for 24-bit signal processing to provide a wide dynamic range and natural sound quality.The D/A converter uses a 20-bit DAC for all 6 channels (5.1 channels).The power amplifier uses Nakamichi's unique HTA (Harmonic Time Alignment) technology.This technology focuses on the time lag between the music signal and the distortion component, and realizes excellent characteristics by minimizing NFB, which is the largest cause of the time lag, and by designing a circuit that keeps the amount of NFB within the audible band constant.The power stage is a fully discrete 5-channel configuration.The power supply section uses separate power transformers for the front & rear 4 ch and center ch, and a multi-regulated power supply to prevent mutual interference between the power supply sections.Two digital inputs, coaxial and optical, are installed.In addition, it is equipped with input jacks for 7 audio input channels and 4 video input channels, and S-Video jacks for monitor output and all video input channels.It has a built-in synthesizer tuner capable of presetting 30 FM/AM stations.Equipped with 2-position surround playback mode of Natural and Hall.Equipped with a level-adjustable subwoofer output.Equipped with tone control with bypass function.Equipped with a loudness switch that can compensate for sound quality at low volume.Equipped with a system remote function, you can control the connected Nakamichi CD player and cassette deck.Uses a 2-way binding post speaker terminal.Wireless remote control with learning function is included.

sections.title: NAKAMICHI 530
sections.overview: A high-quality stereo receiver that can be used as a second main system.The tuner section has a self-lock tuning mechanism.In this system, a kind of electronic servo is operated by detecting the deviation of the local oscillation frequency to suppress the tuning deviation forcibly. In the 530, this self-lock tuning is linked to the motor drive mechanism for self-tuning by soft touch, and four preset stations are also available.A low-noise dual-gate MOS-FET is used in the front end section to reduce various kinds of distortion generated in the high-frequency Zofuku-ji Temple. In addition, multi-stage tuning is performed by an air varicon, which is essentially excellent as a tuning element, to increase the image interference ratio, IF interference ratio, spurious interference ratio, etc., and excellent interference rejection capability is obtained.A specially selected high-quality ceramic filter is used in the IF section to achieve both low strain and selectivity.The MPX section uses a PLL circuit to suppress degradation of the separation and enable stable stereo reproduction.If you want to receive only broadcasting stations with high antenna input sensitivity, turn the threshold switch off. If you want to receive broadcasting stations with high antenna input sensitivity, turn the switch on (20 dBf).Equipped with an automuting mechanism.If the tuning point deviates from the tuning point during auto tuning or 4-station preset tuning, muting is automatically applied to eliminate inter-station noise.The phono equalizer circuit of the preamplifier uses a double-N circuit to prevent degradation of the input signal and to reduce distortion.Pure complimentary service circuit is used for the basic circuit of the power amplifier section to reduce power loss and heat generation.The distortion is also reduced by using a double NF circuit in which NF is applied to the input capacitor.

sections.title: NAKAMICHI 730
sections.overview: A stereo receiver with a compact auto-tuner and high output amplifier.A pure complimentary service push-pull circuit is used in the power amplifier section. The 730 has been specially designed to reduce power loss and provides a high output of 105W + 105W while suppressing heat generation.In addition, a double NF circuit that applies NF to the input capacitor is adopted, and by reducing distortion, the same effect as that of a DC amplifier is obtained.In the power amplifier section, power amplifier circuits are densely integrated on a diecast substrate with independent left and right channels, and further integrated with a heat sink.This eliminates interference between the left and right channels and improves self-compensation for temperature changes.The power supply section is equipped with a large toroidal orient-core power transformer weighing 5.2 kg and a large smoothing capacitor.The basic circuit of the preamplifier section has a luxurious circuit configuration with three transistors connected in parallel to achieve a phono input conversion noise of -137dB. In addition to the NF circuit of the whole circuit, the input capacitor is also equipped with an NF circuit to provide the same effect as a DC amplifier.The preamp section uses a C-MOS analog switch to electrically switch functions, which avoids the sound quality degradation caused by the routing of wires.With a built-in recording amplifier, when the input gain of the tape deck is insufficient, the volume of the rear panel can be used for 10 dB push-up.The tuner section uses a motor drive mechanism and a self-lock tuning mechanism to make an auto tuner from an orthodox tuner using an air varicon, thereby avoiding the sacrifice of reception characteristics associated with automation.The 2-stage low-noise dual-gate MOS-FET and 4-stage air varicon are used in the front end section to reduce distortion and improve the accuracy of the relation between the tuning stages.The IF stage consists of two stages, SAQ (surface acoustic wave filter) and ceramic filter (4-element one wafer), and high selectivity is obtained without deteriorating the distortion factor.A PLL circuit is used in the MPX section to maintain stable separation characteristics.The self-lock tuning circuit detects the deviation of the local oscillation frequency and forcibly suppresses the tuning deviation. The optimum tuning point can be obtained even if the pointer moves slightly on the dial scale, and the optimum tuning is maintained because the pointer itself moves in conjunction with the motor drive mechanism.An attenuator is mounted on the rear panel to suppress the occurrence of excessive input distortion in a strong electric field.Can drop by -20dB with one touch.Preset tuning of 4 stations is possible.If you want to receive only broadcasting stations with high antenna input sensitivity, turn the threshold switch off. If you want to receive broadcasting stations with high antenna input sensitivity, turn the switch on (20 dBf).Equipped with an FM mute switch, noise between stations can be reduced during channel selection.It features -14dB audio muting and tone control, and contour volume to compensate for the lack of high and low tones for human ears.Speaker selector and wireless remote controller sold separately can be used.

sections.title: NAKAMICHI RECEIVER1
sections.overview: A receiver equipped with a unique harmonic time alignment amplifier.The amplifier section is designed using Nakamichi's original harmonic time alignment theory.The Harmonic Time Alignment Theory was proposed by Steve Kalison, a former researcher at the Nakamichi America Research Center. The theory states that "sound is good when the music signal and its harmonic distortion are aligned in time." This is related to the phenomenon that an amplifier with more distortion sometimes produces better sound than an amplifier with less distortion.The amplifier circuit used in the Receiver1 was developed based on this theory. It uses a wide-band, low-gain open loop design to keep the amount of NFB in the audio band constant. In addition, the amount of NFB itself is suppressed slightly, and a method to adjust the fundamental sound and distortion components correctly in time is applied.In addition, it is equipped with a power amplifier with excellent current supply capability to support low-impedance speakers.The power supply section employs a multi-regulated power supply system that independently regulates each stage of the amplifier, tuner section, display circuit, and logic circuit to prevent interference between sections.The ground circuit also uses a unique isolated ground system to shut out interference noise around the ground line.The tone control circuit uses a circuit that can adjust both ends of the frequency band without changing the characteristics of the middle band.This circuit can be lost.A quartz-lock synthesizer is used for the tuner section.This circuit uses a multiplex stage with a precision ceramic oscillator to ensure high selectivity, and an RF amplifier with a low-noise dual-gate MOS FET to provide high sensitivity and excellent reception performance that is robust against overloads.In addition, an isolation buffer is provided at the tuner output stage to prevent adverse effects of high-frequency noise on the audio signal.FM/AM10-station preset memories are installed.A motor-driven volume is used to prevent the deterioration of sound quality that occurs with electronic volume, while enabling volume adjustment by remote control.The Receiver1 has a video input / output connector in addition to an audio input / output connector.It also has a separate output selector for playback and recording.Equipped with a wide-band video buffer amplifier.Equipped with variable loudness control.Built-in pre-out / main in terminal.Equipped with high-speed protection circuit.It comes with a system remote control that allows you to operate the connected Nakamichi component as well as the receiver.By using the optional remote sensor RS-7, remote control is possible from a room other than the room in which the system is placed.Up to three RS-7 units can be connected, and the same remote controller as the included wireless remote controller is sold separately and can be added for use in a separate room.In addition, it is equipped with a remote selection function of speaker A/B so that you can select two pairs of speakers to sound.

sections.overview: FM/AM stereo receiver equipped with STASIS circuit.STASIS circuit is mounted in the amplifier section.This circuit can transmit the input signal to the speaker without any distortion by pure class A operation, and controls the speaker by providing a large class AB current supply capability in the current amplifier stage.In the preamplifier section, the input stages of the equalizer amplifier and the line amplifier are differential inputs, and the sy feed section of the line amplifier is a fully discrete configuration to ensure pure signal transmission.To prevent interference between internal circuits, the video amplifier, tuner, and display parts are carefully laid out so as not to adversely affect the audio circuit.The power supply uses a multi-regulated power supply that separates the power supply for each amplifier / stage, and an isolated ground system that eliminates interference from the ground line.The tuner section can switch between Wide and Narrow two stages of the IF band.In addition, AM and FM can be stored in memory for 10 stations at random. sections.title: NAKAMURA NSXJ
sections.overview:
* Made-to-order products  1,200,000 (around 1994)

This is a stereo power amplifier manufactured using an output transformer developed by Nakamura Manufacturing Co., Ltd., which manufactures power transformers, etc., based on research conducted for many years.300B and 274B are used for vacuum tubes.The circuit is designed with no feedback.The output transformer is a large transformer with a weight of approximately 4.5 kg and a weight of approximately 5.6 kg including the cover.Permalloy is used for the core material, which was selected because it has an excellent distortion factor of more than 1 kHz compared with the equivalent standard of silicon steel plate, although it has the same low frequency range.A cut-core transformer is used for the power transformer.The transformer and choke are mounted on the base with Du Pont and Resorcein as vibration countermeasures.In addition, Du Pont is used for the transformer cover and chassis to reduce vibration and reduce the effect on sound quality.Based on the results of interviews, we use Multi-Cap and SCR France film capacitors, Panasonic X-PRO for electrolytic capacitors, Riken RMG for resistors, and Tokyo Kohon P-65CS for volume capacitors.Glass-epoxy printed circuit boards are used for component mounting.In the XJ600S, the wiring is done by a method similar to direct wiring using pin terminals at important points without depending only on the pattern. sections.title: NEC A-10
sections.overview: This pre-main amplifier was completed by focusing on the ideal amplifier and basic performance, and by putting all NEC's technologies into it.In addition to five stage independent power supply units, a newly developed reserved power supply unit is installed in the power supply unit.In the case of conventional capacitor input type power supply, since the current is discontinuous pulse flow by repetition of 100 Hz to 120 Hz, there is a time when the current does not flow, and there is a disadvantage that the power supply voltage drops even if a large output is obtained when the capacitor is discharged.To overcome this drawback, a reserve power supply was developed. When the charging current is interrupted, a second power supply is activated to bring the charging current closer to a continuous uniform flow.This reduces the peak value of the charging current, reduces the impedance of the power supply, and increases the current supply capacity. The power supply ripple is also reduced by approximately 8 dB, enabling low-frequency reproduction without distortion even at high output.Equipped with a high-gain MC head amplifier.It is high positive with 3 para push connection of low noise and high gain FET, and it corresponds to the size of the output depending on the type of cartridge between low position and high position equipment.It is equipped with an operation switch that can be used to separate the preamplifier and power amplifier.When the switch is set to "SEPARATED", the input of the power amplifier section and the output of the preamplifier section are separated, so that they can be used independently.The input level of the power amplifier section is adjustable independently on the left and right.Equipped with a subsonic filter.Three stage (-10, -20 and -30dB) attenuators are provided for precise volume control.Equipped with a power output level control that can be used as an output volume when a balance control or power amplifier is used independently.Equipped with a REC selector.

sections.title: NEC A-10III
sections.overview: Based on the A-10TypeII, this pre-main amplifier has a stronger and more rigid structure and improved reserve power supply system.The structure uses a unique mechanical ground construction.In this system, the vibration of each part is completely suppressed by the material and structure, and the vibration of each part with different vibration modes is cancelled by each other in the whole structure by computer simulation. This simplified vibration is dropped on a huge leg and connected to the earth to suppress it.The A-10TypeIII has been further strengthened and refined. It has a structure in which all mechanical vibrations are received by the legs with the occasional reference point of the set itself as the legs of the main body. Sintered alloy legs 50 mm in diameter and 22 mm in height are adopted for the insulators arranged in four places of the bottom plate.In addition, a 3.2 mm thick steel plate is used for the bottom plate in order to securely connect the structural parts and power transformer to the legs.In addition, a cross-beam is used to integrate the left and right side fittings, rear panel, and heat sink. The bottom and cross-beam are connected by four beams, and the core of the power transformer is securely fixed to the beams.In addition, a chimney type heat sink is adopted to prevent fin squeal.With this rigid structure, the main body and the ground are firmly grounded to eliminate the cloudy and cloudy sound caused by the relative relationship between the material and structure of the ground plane and the amplifier.In addition to the normal 4-leg grounding, the insulator can be selected from 2 legs at the rear + 1 leg at the front and 1 leg at the rear + 2 legs at the front.In order to approach the ideal image of the amplifier as "one wire with amplification degree", the Simple & Straight concept is adopted, and pure quality is realized by one contact direct connection in which all of attached circuits are jumped as necessary.In order to enjoy the excellent dynamic range and high quality of digital sources such as CDs, it has a direct input to the power amplifier section.In the A-10TypeIII, the quality improvement of the Phono series is re-examined. The EQ amplifier is equipped with DC servo, and the Phono direct position, which connects the Phono amplifier and the power amplifier directly with one contact by using a highly reliable relay, is installed.The REC selector method allows you to record your favorite source regardless of the source being played.In addition, a large vise type screw terminal is adopted to ensure the connection of a very thick speaker cord. This also enables the rear panel supporting the speaker terminal to be made of non-magnetic material. This eliminates magnetic material from the loop of the speaker output current and eliminates electrical disturbance.The AC outlet is equipped with a line filter to prevent noise from entering and jumping.This AC outlet operates unswitched and has polarity indication.Signals recorded in commercially available CD software have both positive and reverse polarity.The A-10TypeIII is equipped with a polarity inversion Pre Out terminal for reverse polarity software in order to manage the polarity of the entire system.Reverse polarity By connecting the Pre Out and Main In with the attached U-shaped pin, the polarity can be reversed at the separate position of operation SW. This enables total polarity alignment.The power supply section uses a large reserved power supply system.In order to maintain a large output even when the capacitor is discharged, another power supply is prepared to compensate for the time when the charging current of the capacitor input type rectifier circuit does not flow. By delaying the phase of the output by 90  , the ripple valley of the main power supply is filled, and it is equivalent to a battery power supply.In addition, the A-10TypeIII has approximately 20% higher current capacity of the power transformer and capacity of the smoothing capacitor, and further lower power impedance, making it an even better power source.A push-pull type amplifier circuit is used for all amplification stages, and superlinearity 2SA-1227 and 2SC-2987 utilizing NEC's semiconductor technology are used for the final amplification stage in parallel push-pull configuration.By using output transistors in parallel, the effective halving of the emitter resistance, which enters the output current circuit in series, is avoided without loss of stability.In addition, the output circuit is designed so that the protection by the ASO limiter is not necessary even with 2   load. Therefore, the limiter that impairs the linearity of the output current does not operate even with 2   load.

sections.title: NEC A-10IV
sections.overview: Pre-main amplifier further developed and improved from A-10TypeIII.In addition to the CD Direct Input and Phono Direct Position installed in the TypeIII, the TypeIV uses a direct main amplifier.In order to minimize the influence of the relay contact of the protection circuit which exists just before the speaker terminal, the speaker direct terminal is adopted. By achieving the direct drive of the speaker, the quality is further improved.In addition, NEC original OCC shielded cable is used for the wiring inside the amplifier to reproduce bright and transparent atmosphere, glossy sound and energy feeling.As for the volume, we have adopted a higher quality model and a constant current drive system that is less affected by contact points.It is equipped with reserve power supply III which is an improvement of NEC original reserve power supply.Compared with the A-10TypeIII, the capacity of the smoothing capacitor has been increased by more than 16%. It is equipped with a huge capacity of 93,200 ? F in total with a conventional power supply of 20,000 ? Fx4 and a reserve power supply of 3,300 ? Fx4. The capacity to supply the charging current from the reserve to the conventional is improved, and the excellent recovery capability after a large output provides an extremely smooth power waveform.We have also improved the transmission of load fluctuations from the secondary side of the transformer to the primary side and noise contamination from the primary side to the secondary side of the transformer.In addition, the power cord is a very thick OFC (oxygen-free copper) cord, and a fuse with a lead is used as a fuse holder to supply power directly to the primary side of the transformer without two intervening contacts. Thus, the purity of the power supply part is thoroughly refined.Mechanical ground construction is used for rigid structural design.Each part is made of carefully selected materials and structures that thoroughly suppress vibration. On top of that, the natural vibration of each part is made to cancel each other by computer simulation. Finally, the controlled simple vibration is incorporated into a huge leg.TypeIV is further tuned to increase the density of the sintered alloy legs with improved signal quality and power supply system.In addition, the power transformer is enclosed in a copper-plated case to suppress the vibration characteristic of the power transformer. At the same time, the transformer is made non-magnetic to prevent adverse effects caused by magnetic flux leakage.A rectifier diode is also enclosed in the transformer case to suppress rectification noise.As with TypeIII and other products, you can choose between 4/3 landing gear contact, point contact, and contact area in order to select the installation environment of the amplifier and subtle sound quality differences.A push-pull amplifier circuit is used for all amplifier stages.In addition, by adopting a parallel push-pull configuration for the final amplifier stage, the emitter resistance which goes in series with the output current circuit is reduced by half without loss of safety, and the output circuit does not require protection by an ASO limiter even with 2   load.In order to manage the polarity of the system as a whole, including reverse polarity software and reverse motion speakers, a polarity inversion Pre Out terminal is mounted.Reverse polarity By connecting the Pre Out and Main In with a U-shaped pin, the polarity can be reversed with the operation switch in the separate position and total polarity adjustment is possible.Equipped with a REC selector system, it is possible to record FM broadcasts while listening to CDs.In order to minimize the effect of sound quality due to magnetic flux leakage, etc., the front chassis is made non-magnetic by copper plating. In addition, a non-magnetic material is used for the rear panel to remove magnetic material from the loop of the output current of the speaker, thereby eliminating various electrical disturbances.The speaker terminal is a large vise type that can be used with very thick speaker cables.

sections.title: NEC A-700
sections.overview: This is a pre-main amplifier with improved operability for the AV age while applying NEC's original technology such as reserve II power supply.A push-pull type amplifier circuit is adopted for all amplifier stages and a parallel push-pull configuration is adopted for the final amplifier stage. By using output transistors in parallel, the effective halving due to the emitter resistance entering the output current circuit in series can be achieved without loss of stability.In addition, by developing an output circuit that does not require protection by an ASO limiter even under 2   load, the limiter that impairs linearity of output power is set not to operate.The power supply section is equipped with NEC's original reserve II power supply.This circuit uses another power supply to compensate for the dead time of the capacitor input type rectifier circuit. The phase of the output is delayed by 90 degrees and the ripple valley is filled. This enhances stability.This solves the problem that the power supply voltage drops even if a large output is obtained when the capacitor is discharged, which occurs in the conventional capacitor input type power supply.The AC outlet is equipped with a line filter to cut power supply noise.Mechanical ground construction is adopted as vibration resistant and rigid structural design.By revising the chassis structure to clarify not only the ground potential, which is the electrical reference point, but also the ground point of mechanical vibration, we are reducing the adverse effect of mechanical vibration on the electrical circuit.The A-700 has a structure in which all mechanical vibrations are received by the legs with the occasional reference point of the set itself as the legs of the main body, and the bottom plate is made of sintered alloy of 50 mm diameter and 22 mm height.In addition, in order to securely connect the structural parts and power transformer to the legs, a 2.0 mm thick steel plate is used for the bottom plate. In addition, a cross beam is used to integrally structure the left and right side fittings, rear panel and heat sink. The core of the power transformer is securely fixed to the beam by connecting the bottom plate and cross beam with two beams.As a result, distortion, crosstalk, and deterioration of phase characteristics due to fluctuation of stray capacitance and stray inductance on the signal line are suppressed, and comfortable low sound and sharp high sound are obtained.In the past, the tone circuit was equipped with a bypass circuit such as tone defeat, and it was dealt with by switching the switch. However, even in this case, the signal passes through the switch contact, and the sound quality deteriorates.To cope with this problem, we have developed and adopted a main direct tone circuit that directly controls the characteristics of the main amplifier itself by feeding the signal directly to the main amplifier without passing through the extra amplifier and switch contact.In addition, focusing on group delay characteristics during music playback, especially dispersion of the left and right channels, we have achieved a tone circuit with excellent sense of location by setting optimum values for group delay, phase and amplitude characteristics through computer simulation, controlling impedance and correction curve of both bass and treble volumes, and using audio parts carefully selected for controlling tolerance of circuit constants.A high-gain equalizer amplifier is also available for analog playback.The differential amplifier uses a low-noise Hi GmFET with excellent sound quality, and is equipped with a dedicated shunt-type power supply.Equipped with two input terminals and one output terminal for visual equipment.

sections.overview: AV Surround Center with digital delay.Equipped with a digital delay, analog signals are A/D converted once and controlled in digital form, resulting in significant improvements in characteristics.This circuit consists of a 16-bit linear successive approximation type A/D converter, 16KbitS-RAM and address control IC, and can set a delay time of 15/20/30msec.Three surround modes are available : Dolby surround, hall surround, and matrix surround.Dolby Surround obtains surround information by adding a subtle time delay to the (L-R) difference signal in addition to the normal 2 ch signal. In Hall Surround, normal stereo playback is performed from the front speaker, and a composite signal of reflected sound (L + R), assuming a concert hall, is echoed from the rear surround speaker.In matrix surround, a 2 ch signal, which is a slight mixture of left and right signals, is played back from the front, and the reverse phase component of the opposite ch is added from the rear.Equipped with a surround indicator that allows you to check the current surround control status at a glance.You can turn it off if you don't need it.When playing Whole Surround, you can adjust the amount of surround echo to your preference.Equipped with a full mute switch, you can stop all sounds at once.It is equipped with three types of volume : a master volume that can adjust the volume of all channels simultaneously, a 4-mode balance volume that can control the front 2 ch / rear 2ch/R-side 2ch/L-side 2 ch, and an individual volume for each channel.It is equipped with a synthetic stereo function, and by passing a monaural signal through a digital signal processing circuit, it can be converted into a pseudo stereo.A bypass position is provided when surround sound is not necessary.It is equipped with tone control which can adjust the sound quality of front and rear respectively.It has a built-in image enhancer that corrects the contour of unclear images and reproduces clearer images.The enhanced amount can be switched between 2 levels of 3 db and 6 db.Equipped with a 4-channel independent power amplifier.This amplifier can also be used as a 2-channel amplifier by BTL connection.It comes with a wireless remote control that enables you to change the surround sound, select the delay time, and adjust the volume of each channel.The memory function of this remote control allows you to store up to three types of surround position, volume and delay time.

sections.title: NEC AV-300PRO
sections.overview: An AV Surround Center that supports Dolby Pro Logic Surround.Equipped with a Dolby Surround Decoder, it supports Dolby Pro Logic Surround.In addition, in order to keep the Dolby Pro Logic in the best state at all times, it is equipped with an auto input balance that automatically adjusts the Lch and Rch level balance of the input signal.The center channel is equipped with a dual center function to improve the orientation of the center.A newly developed parametric equalizer is also installed to adjust the sound quality of the center channel when the center speaker is different from the front speaker.Equipped with 2 channel independent digital delay circuit.The delay time is in the range of 0 msec ~ 30 msec (in the case of Dolby Pro Logic, the left and right channels can be independently set in the range of 15 msec ~ 30 msec), and fine adjustment of 1.5 msec steps is possible.The master volume uses a motor drive that can be controlled by a remote controller.Equipped with three center channel modes.Normal mode is suitable for use with small center speakers. Signals below 100 Hz are cut off and sent to the center channel, while signals below 100 Hz are sent to the left and right of the front.The wide mode is suitable for using a bookshelf type or larger speaker as the center, and the signal is sent directly to the center channel.In phantom mode, the center speaker is not used and the signal is divided to the left and right of the front.Equipped with 3-channel logic mode suitable for cases where the rear speaker is not used.In this mode, the surround signal is output from the left and right sides of the front, so that the rear speaker is positioned in the expected position.The power amplifier section has excellent characteristics by making all 5 amplifiers discrete configuration.The AV selector, surround, attenuator (sound level), test tone, sound output level and steering meter (sound localization) operation status can be displayed on the LCD and on-screen.In addition, the on-screen display can be selected from off, 3, 5, 7 or 9 seconds on the system set screen.Depending on the input level, the ATT level can be preset in the range of 1 dB steps from 0 dB to 13 dB.The ATT circuit uses a discrete ATT circuit that uses bipolar transistors to emphasize sound quality.It is equipped with a test tone using a noise sequencer, and the volume balance of each channel can be adjusted.Equipped with a REC selector, REC sound selector and REC monitor.Equipped with a sleep timer function, it can be set up to 3 hours in units of 10 minutes.AUTO FADE OUT operates one minute before the power is turned off by the timer.Equipped with BSVA system control function capable of controlling with NEC BSVA system.Comes with a multi-functional wireless remote control with learning capabilities.By remote control operation, volume balance of each channel of 5 ch and volume of channel 5 ch can be controlled in 1 db step.In addition to the silver model, there was also a black model.

sections.title: NEC AV-7000D
sections.overview: Digital / surround amplifier with twin PLL.The A-10 series is equipped with an NEC original reserve power supply. The phase of the output is delayed by 90 degrees and the ripple valley is filled with another power supply. This improves low-frequency playback at high output.A twin PLL circuit is installed in order to accurately tune sources with different sampling frequencies and to perform more accurate conversion with a D/A converter.In this circuit, the PLL circuit for clock extraction is composed of two stages in series which greatly reduces jitter and improves sound quality.The D/A converter is equipped with an 8 x oversampling digital filter, which reduces the load on the low-pass filter by making the digital audio signal closer to a smooth and continuous waveform and making the non-audio signal extremely high-frequency components, thereby increasing the passband and reducing phase distortion.In addition, by adopting a twin configuration for the ?????? D/A converter that does not require a degrizer circuit, the phase difference between the left and right channels is eliminated and the S/N ratio is improved.It is equipped with a surround circuit of Dolby surround and Hall surround.The delay circuit uses a well-established digital delay to achieve surround sound reproduction with less noise.The selector function can be used even in the power standby state.Equipped with a digital direct switch, when the switch is turned on, the desired source can be selected only with the digital input switch regardless of the status of the digital / analog switch.In this state, the surround circuit does not operate.Equipped with a BS Rec switch, you can record satellite broadcasts using video and audio devices connected to the Video1, Video2 and Tape2 jacks regardless of the state of other switches.Equipped with a REC selector that can record programs other than the monitor.It is also equipped with a surround selector that enables video and audio to cross each other for recording and recording.Equipped with speaker off switch and mono-out terminal.The volume has a motor volume that can be adjusted with a remote control.It comes with a wireless remote control and can also control the NEC BS tuners NE-BST5000 and NE-BST2000.

sections.title: NEC CD-10
sections.overview: CD player announced as new reference of NEC.The digital filter uses a 16 fs Transversal Filtering Circuit (TFC).Using an 8 fs digital filter, the signal sampled at a given sampling period and the signal delayed by half of the sampling period with respect to the signal are subjected to arithmetic averaging to produce average value complementary data.With this 16 fs TFC, the hold aperture time is 14 ? sec, and even at 20 kHz, the highest recording frequency for CD, a smooth waveform is obtained without the need for a low-pass filter.The CD-10 uses a 16 fs TFC gate array to achieve a simpler and straighter configuration.The D/A conversion circuit is equipped with a 4 dac B. S. S (Balanced Summing System), a balanced return circuit that uses two D/A converters on the left and right, each of which is specially selected for accuracy at a small level from among the DACs selected for good linearity.The balance operation of unipolar DACs eliminates the need for a coupling capacitor and simplifies the analog signal circuit.The power supply uses an extremely thick DFC ACF cord and is equipped with an A/D completely independent 2-transformer.In addition, we have adopted an independent power supply system in which the secondary winding is divided for each stage to prevent mutual interference between analog and digital systems in the power supply.In addition, as a result of pursuing dynamic dynamism, all electrolytic capacitors are made of high-voltage products with a margin. In addition, important parts of power supply lines are wired with wires (#18) with a large cross-sectional area and a thick film without relying on pattern wiring to improve the quality.The chassis structure uses a fully A/D separated 2 box chassis to prevent digital noise from entering.The inside of the chassis is separated into a mechanism digital system and a D/A conversion / analog system. In addition, the digital system and analog system each have a base and an earth point is independent, preventing the mixing of digital noise.Focusing on the relationship between vibration and sound, direct mechanical ground construction is adopted.The mechanical base legs are made of sintered alloy and the mechanical tray is filled with anti-vibration material to prevent resonance. The power transformer, which is the source of vibration inside the CD player, is fixed to the transformer base of 3.2 mm thick steel plate insulated from the chassis through a special anti-vibration material of 1 mm, so that it is vibrationally and electrically separated.In addition, the chassis base plate adopts a 3-layer structure consisting of an ordinary 1 mm thick steel plate plus 2 mm thick and 1.6 mm thick steel plates. The entire high-rigidity housing is monocoque. Simple and controlled vibrations with reduced natural vibrations are transmitted to the ground through giant heavy-weight legs (65   380g).Balanced output jacks are provided, and unbalanced output jacks are provided with positive and negative output jacks.The unbalanced output terminal uses a stand-alone, high-ground type that does not share a common ground.Uses a simple LED9-digit display.In addition, in order to eliminate the adverse effect on sound quality caused by turning on the display, it is equipped with an off position. When turned off, a relay is used to shut off the power supply.In addition, it is equipped with 3 levels of dimmer switch which can choose bright display or dim display.Equipped with an absolute phase (signal polarity) change-over switch that adjusts the polarity of the whole system.

sections.overview: CD player with 16-bit digital filter and twin D/A converter.An optical transmission system is used to eliminate digital noise from analog circuits.In this system, signals from digital circuits are converted into optical signals and transmitted to analog circuits. sections.overview: A CD player developed by putting in the technology obtained with the CD 830 ds.Equipped with a 16 fs T. F. C. (Transversal Filtering Circuit), the sampling frequency is shifted up 16 times to 705.6 kHz by high-precision digital calculation, and the digital noise is shifted to the ultra-high frequency to obtain a smooth waveform.As a result, the analog filter in the latter stage becomes a simple second order passive type compared to the conventional one, and the passband is expanded, and element distortion and phase distortion are greatly improved.The D/A conversion section uses a 4 dac B. sections.title: NEC CD-830DS
sections.overview: A CD player equipped with new technologies such as newly developed digital servo and optical pickup with built-in I/V amplifier.A newly developed 16 fs Transversal Filtering Circuit is mounted.In this circuit, an average interpolation system is constructed by adding a signal with 1/2 times delayed period to the signal with 8 times over-sampling. Since the sampling frequency is pseudo-doubled, the hold aperture time becomes 1.4 ? sec, which is 1/2 of the 8 times over-sampling time, and a smoother waveform is obtained. In addition, random noise becomes 1 /   2 by adding data, and S/N ratio improvement of about 3 dB is achieved. Furthermore, the energy to be interpolated by the low-pass filter becomes half (-6dB), which reduces the load on the low-pass filter, making it possible to expand the passband and improve the phase distortion.The 4 dac Balanced Summing System is used for the D/A conversion part.This system uses two D/A converters each for Lch and Rch. The in-phase noise of the + and - D/A converters can be canceled each other, and at the same time, the random noise can be reduced to 1 /   2. The S/N ratio is improved by more than 3 dB compared to the conventional system.In addition, a Glitchless D/A converter has been adopted to simplify the circuit configuration by cutting off the sample-and-hold circuit that generates spike noise and adversely affects sound quality.An optical pickup with a built-in I/V amplifier is used for the pickup section, which integrates a PIN photodiode with a 6-division pattern and six I/V conversion amplifiers with a single power supply operation on the same chip by making full use of a bipolar process with two layer wiring and reducing the chip size and shielding the IC section.As a result, the output of the optical pickup becomes a voltage-variable type and the output impedance can be lowered, reducing the influence of external noise, reducing the error rate and improving the sound quality.We have developed and installed the world's first digital servo circuit in order to realize faithful and optimum servo.This servo circuit consists of a newly developed dedicated LSI ? PD6353G, which integrates a digital loop filter for focus servo and tracking servo, a PWM (pulse width modulation) output circuit, a one track jump control circuit, a track jump counter, a brake circuit, an RF signal detection circuit, and an RF comparator on one chip.By integrating the focus servo and tracking servo independently, an arbitrary filter coefficient (gain, time constant, etc.) can be set by the system control microcomputer according to the change of the pickup condition. Unlike conventional analog servo circuits with fixed filter coefficient, the servo is flexible and faithful to the change of the signal from the disk.In addition, the integration of IC functions improves reliability, and the PWM (Pulse Width Modulation) drive of the pickup servo reduces energy loss at the servo driver stage.A 2.0 mm thick steel plate is used for the bottom plate, and the center chassis is used to absorb microvibration from the internal rotation system. In addition, the structure is resistant to external vibration by making the sintered alloy legs (  66 / 18 mm) with high rigidity and excellent vibration resistance adhere to the floor surface. (Point contact and interview site can be selected)The digital stage and analog stage are completely separated from the power transformer to prevent noise from entering the analog stage.Equipped with an absolute phase (signal polarity) change-over switch, it is possible to match the polarity of the whole system with that of the source.Equipped with digital (optical / coaxial) output.An optical transmission method is used to prevent adverse effects caused by digital signals.Very thick OFC cord is used for the power cord.Equipped with performance time editing functions such as digital fade-out function, auto-edit function, manual edit function, disc change edit function, auto-space function, and display of music within remaining time.In addition, the following functions are available : delete program playback, random play, introscan, 24-track random program memory, 3-mode repeat function between all songs / programs / A and B, time search, track search, index search, 2-speed music search, power ON start function, and 6 types of time display.It uses a large display with a music calendar with 3 levels of brightness switching.Equipped with a headphone port with volume.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.title: NEC CD-903
sections.overview: A CD player that pursues musicality with carefully selected materials and luxurious circuit design.The D/A converter employs a 4-channel independent D/A converter that completely separates the right and left channels and the four channels of positive and negative phases. This realizes a perfectly balanced transmission and eliminates the ambiguity associated with phase. In addition, even after analog conversion, 4-channel independent circuits are employed to prevent mutual interference.It is equipped with error correction, EFM decoder and microcomputer for control newly developed by making full use of NEC technology to improve accuracy and reliability of signal processing.As for digital filters, we have reduced phase shift and distortion by polishing our original ND filter.Optical transmission of digital signals is achieved by four optical cables, two for serial data, one for clock signal and one for latch pulse, and five photocouplers for control signal.As a result, the electronic coupling between the digital circuit and the analog circuit is cut off and the mixing of digital noise is prevented.Equipped with a low distortion rate analog attenuator that can control 0 to 29 dB in 1 dB steps.It consists of a high-reliability and high-sound quality resistor and a sealed relay with gold-plated crossbar contacts.A 3.2 mm thick steel plate is used for the bottom plate to absorb microvibration from the internal rotation system.In addition, by making the legs of sintered alloy with high rigidity and excellent vibration resistance adhere to the floor surface, the structure is strong against long-period vibration and external vibration.In addition, 1.6 mm thick steel plate is used for the chassis itself, and 5 mm thick aluminum plate is used for the side plate, top plate and front surface.The output jacks are equipped with balanced input jacks and two types of unbalanced output jacks (positive and negative).Equipped with a full-function wireless remote commander.

sections.title: NEC AV-250
sections.overview: An AV surround processor with a Dolby surround decoder.It is compatible with Dolby Surround, which reproduces surround information by adding a subtle time delay to the (L-R) difference signal in addition to the normal 2 ch signal.It has two surround functions, matrix surround and hall surround.In matrix surround, the 2 ch signal, which is a slight mixture of left and right signals, is sent from the front, and the reverse phase component of the opposite ch is added from the rear to increase the sense of spaciousness.In Hall Surround, the normal 2 ch signal is played back from the front, and the (L + R) composite signal is echoed from the rear.It is equipped with four input terminals for video equipment and one input terminal for audio equipment. At the same time, it is equipped with output terminals that allow editing of up to three devices and two mono outputs that are convenient for connecting a subwoofer or center channel.It is equipped with a stereo power amplifier that can drive the front or rear speakers. This amplifier has an independent input terminal and can operate independently.It also has a 4-channel pre-out terminal that can be connected to an external amplifier to control all surround selectors and volume.If the built-in decoder exceeds the maximum allowable input, an overload indicator will light to indicate this.It is equipped with three types of volumes : master volume, 4-mode balance control volume, and individual volume for each channel.Equipped with a one touch preset volume function (sound memory function), you can store up to types of volume and balance according to your preference.It is equipped with a Hall Effect Control function that can adjust the amount of sound echo in Hall Surround.It comes with a remote control that can control 3-mode surround sound, volume adjustment, balance adjustment, volume memory, etc.This remote control can also control videos such as VC-N8HF, N31, N5, N3, N63, and N65 made by NEC.

sections.title: NEC AVD-700
sections.overview: AV surround decoder equipped with 16-bit digital delay.It is equipped with a 2-channel independent 16-bit digital delay developed by NEC. The characteristics are greatly improved by converting analog signals into A / D once, digitizing them and controlling them.This circuit consists of a 16-bit linear successive approximation type A/D converter, 64kbitS-RAM, and newly developed address control IC. The AVD-700 has two circuits, which enable adjustment of delay time at every 1 msec in the range of 1 to 92 msec independently on the left and right sides.Dolby surround sound is available. With the AVD 700, you can adjust the delay time according to the size of the room and listening point.Equipped with a hall surround function using digital echo.The AVD-700 uses a time-delay echo method to provide a natural feeling of presence in a concert hall. The main speaker is normal stereo playback, and the rear and front surround speakers play back a composite signal of L + R, which is the reflected sound of a concert hall, with echo added to it.The echo delay time can be adjusted independently in 1 msec steps using the digital delay, and the echo volume can be adjusted using the echo control.It is equipped with a matrix surround function, and a surround feeling is obtained by outputting a 2 ch signal, which is a slight mixture of left and right signals, from the front, and a signal added with a reverse phase component of the opposite ch from the rear.Equipped with the Creation Surround function, it is possible to play back with your favorite signal processing.This function allows you to mix the main speaker L/R with the signal of another channel in positive or negative phase, and the surround speaker L/R with the signal of another channel in positive or negative phase. You can also use digital delay and digital delay echo.It is equipped with a mix level control function that can change the sound field by slightly mixing the signal of the opposite channel to each L/R channel.It comes with a wireless remote control that allows you to switch the source input and surround settings, select the delay time, turn echo on/off, and adjust volume.As a memory function, this remote control can store up to three types of positions, such as surround position, delay time, volume and invert SW.

sections.title: NEC AVD-1000PRO
sections.overview: This is a Dolby Prologic decoder that pursues high sound quality by adopting an analog decoder.The VCA uses the TDA1074A, which is the same IC as the professional decoder, and the VCA offset trimmer (professional decoder circuit), which is also used for the professional decoder, to eliminate the degradation of separation caused by the dispersion of VCA.In addition, the VCA control uses F (tolerance of 1%) and G (tolerance of 2%) rank parts for filters and time constant circuits to minimize error voltage caused by variations in circuit parts.For signal switching, a sealed twin crossbar contact relay (the contact is silver plated with gold) is used to guarantee low contact resistance and long-term reliability.In order to minimize degradation of sound quality, 9 motor volumes including the master volume are built in.On the signal path, no semiconductor switching is performed, and the variable signal level is controlled by a motor volume. Eight of these are controlled by a microcomputer. Individual differences in rotational speed are absorbed by the pre-learning function of the microcomputer, and each speed is controlled at a constant value.The power transformer, which is a large source of vibration, is placed in the center to ensure the minimum weight balance, and the body is firmly supported by the 2 mm thick bottom plate and heavyweight legs (380g 65   4-point or 4-facepiece possible).In addition, the power transformers for analog and digital circuits are separated, and the housing is structurally and electrically.In order to match the phases of the Lch/Rch of the input signal with each other, an auto-azimuth circuit adjusts the phase shift in real time to achieve accurate sound movement and localization.(Retraction Range or Lock Range   15   1 khz)Equipped with an auto / input balance circuit, it automatically compensates for variations in input signals in real time.It is equipped with a user logic function that allows you to create your favorite sound field. You can use the parameter set and surround invert functions.In the parameter set, you can enjoy your favorite sound field by combining the effect of the directional enhancement circuit (EFFECT Fr/Re) and the cutoff frequency of the low-pass filter for surround channels (SR Cutoff).By using a decorrelated DSP (Digital Signal Processor), you can expand the surround area and achieve the same effect as using two rear speakers.It is equipped with newly developed large display tubes including the controller.Equipped with an external input terminal for 4-channel HDTV broadcasting (3-1 format).Various test tone functions allow for optimum system settings.In the system test tone, the sound image of the test tone moves continuously from the front L channel to the center channel to the front R channel to the center channel to the front L channel.Pulse test tones output pulses from both the center and surround channels simultaneously. In this case, the listener can sense the direction of the sound image from the channel where the sound arrives first by the Haas effect, which is useful for setting the delay time.With a parametric equalizer, you can adjust the sound quality of the center channel when the center speaker is different from the front speaker.Uses OFC thick power cord and gold plated terminal.Two types of remote control units (setting remote control / steering remote control) are included.Normal operation can be performed only with the steering remote control.

sections.title: NIKKO C-201
sections.overview: Professional preamplifier with all-FET configuration.The equalizer circuit is a first stage low-noise, two stage differential, three stage amplified group source follower circuit. It is two stage amplified with an RIAA element in between.The C-201 gives an RIAA curve with a CR time constant to avoid the NF type in order to focus on sound quality. This eliminates the phase rotation of the unit amplifier and provides excellent sound quality and fidelity.The CR type cannot be expected to have a good effect on the S/N ratio and dynamic range. However, the C-201 has achieved an excellent S/N ratio by carefully selecting the components used. For example, a low-noise FET and a metal film resistor with less noise components are used. As for the dynamic range, a high-voltage FET with Vds200V is adopted for the first stage unit amplifier in order to be able to withstand a large input in the high-frequency range.In addition to improving the S/N ratio by making the final stage high withstand voltage and using a low-noise FET for the first stage differential, we have also studied the bare characteristics and amplified the signal flattened by the RIAA element at a low distortion rate.The flat amplifier section has a circuit configuration of first stage low noise, two stage differential, three stage amplification, and final stage source follower.The circuit design emphasizes bare characteristics and achieves FLAT characteristics up to ultra-high frequencies, while utilizing the characteristics of the FET element itself to achieve low distortion.It uses a 21-point click type 4 connected volume.Since this volume controls both the input and output of the flat amplifier section, the noise of the equalizer amplifier and flat amplifier is reduced and the S/N ratio in actual use is improved.In addition, a buffer amplifier section using a source follower circuit by FET is mounted to eliminate the change of output impedance due to the use of four connected volumes and to lower the output impedance, and the dynamic range is expanded by applying a voltage of   50 V.In the power supply section, the power supply for the equalizer amplifier and the power supply for the FLAT AMP are wound separately and supplied as a constant voltage to eliminate interference distortion.These constant-voltage power supply circuits are composed of error-amplifying transistors and supply a stable constant voltage to each circuit.The Phono input is provided in the Route 3 so that the load resistance and input capacitance can be changed for CH1, the input capacitance can be changed for CH2, and the load resistance can be changed for CH3. The load resistance can be changed in 5 stages and the input capacitance can be changed in 3 stages, so that the performance of each cartridge can be demonstrated.In addition, a NAB compensation circuit is provided so that not only disks but also tapes can be played directly from the magnetic head, and a FLAT circuit for MIC is also provided.The signal system has been simplified by eliminating the tone control circuit, which enables music playback without signal degradation.Equipped with a protection circuit.The C-201 is equipped with two pairs of full-scale stabilizing power supplies. Large capacitors are used in various parts of the power supply. It takes time to stabilize the power supply after the power switch is turned on. During this time, irregular noise is generated from the amplifier. To prevent this noise, the output and the amplifier circuit are isolated for 10 seconds after the power switch is turned on. When the power switch is turned off, the output is isolated instantly.An indicator display circuit also electronically changes the power indicator from red to green to indicate relay operation.

sections.title: NIKKO M-110
sections.overview: A flagship stereo power amplifier with an AC-DC changeover switch.The M-110 provides a continuous output of 100W + 100W at all stages of Class A operation, and can be used as a DC amplifier.The circuit configuration is a fully symmetrical circuit system using a differential circuit using P-channel and N-channel FETs for the first stage and a 4-stage parallel push-pull circuit using PNP and NPN transistor differential for the next stage. The DC amplifier is a fully symmetrical circuit system with consideration for external variations such as temperature, etc., and the center voltage is not allowed to change when there is no input, and is affected by the circuit configuration and components used. In addition, the circuit configuration is a fully symmetrical circuit system with consideration to external variations such as temperature, etc., and carefully selected high-precision elements are specified.In order to reduce NFB as much as possible with an emphasis on sound quality, we are examining various aspects of bare characteristics. In addition, all power supplies are used as constant voltage circuits to supply a stable constant voltage, thereby enabling low distortion characteristics and reduction of residual noise with less NFB.All power supply parts are made constant voltage. The constant voltage circuit for supplying power to the power stage consists of an error amplifying transistor, a protective transistor, and a control transistor. In particular, four transistors are connected in parallel to the control transistor so that hFE does not decrease even at a large current and control performance does not deteriorate.In addition, four large-capacity capacitors are used, one after rectification and one after constant voltage, and the power transformer uses a cut core of 800 VA to obtain a large output with a sense of volume.Since a class A amplifier always has a large current, a large load is applied when the power switch is turned ON/OFF, causing damage. Therefore, the M-110 uses a relay to control the current to protect the power switch.Since the power is turned on / off by this relay function, even when the power supply of the M-110 is remoted by the preamplifier C-201, the influence on the preamplifier type power switch and other equipment is suppressed, and the design has high reliability.
